recipes.title: Crock Pot Pot Roast with Root Vegetables
recipes.ingredients:
2 1/2 lb chuck roast
1 tbsp oil
3 carrots, cut into chunks
3 potatoes, quartered
1 onion, sliced
3 cloves garlic, minced
2 cups beef broth
1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
1 tbsp tomato paste
1 tsp dried thyme
1 bay leaf
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Season roast generously with salt and pepper, then sear on all sides in hot oil in a skillet until browned.
Place carrots, potatoes, and onion in the bottom of the crock pot.
Set the seared roast on top and scatter garlic around it.
Whisk broth, Worcestershire sauce, tomato paste, thyme, and bay leaf together and pour over the roast.
Cover and cook on Low for 8 hours, or until the meat shreds easily with a fork.
Discard the bay leaf, then slice or shred the roast and serve with the vegetables and pan juices.

recipes.title: Crock Pot Mississippi Pot Roast
recipes.ingredients:
2 1/2 lb chuck roast
1 packet ranch seasoning mix
1 tbsp au jus gravy mix
5 pepperoncini peppers, plus 2 tbsp brine
4 tbsp butter
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Place the chuck roast in the crock pot and season lightly with salt and pepper.
Sprinkle ranch seasoning and au jus mix evenly over the top of the roast.
Scatter pepperoncini peppers and their brine around the roast, then place butter pats on top.
Cover and cook on Low for 8 hours until the roast shreds easily.
Shred the meat directly in the cooking liquid and stir to coat.
Serve the shredded roast with some of the pepperoncini and juices spooned over top.
recipes.notes: Great piled onto sandwich rolls or served over mashed potatoes.

recipes.title: Crock Pot Beef and Barley Soup
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb beef stew meat, cubed
1 tbsp oil
1 onion, diced
2 carrots, sliced
2 celery stalks, sliced
2 cloves garlic, minced
6 cups beef broth
2/3 cup pearl barley
1 can (14.5 oz) diced tomatoes
1 tsp dried thyme
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Brown the beef in oil in a skillet, then transfer to the crock pot.
Add onion, carrots, celery, and garlic to the crock pot.
Pour in broth and diced tomatoes, then stir in barley and thyme.
Cover and cook on Low for 7 hours, or until beef and barley are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste before serving.
Ladle into bowls and serve hot.

recipes.title: Crock Pot Smoky Beef Chili
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb ground beef, browned and drained
1 onion, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 can (15 oz) kidney beans, drained
1 can (15 oz) black beans, drained
1 can (28 oz) crushed tomatoes
2 tbsp chili powder
1 tsp smoked paprika
1 tsp dried oregano
1/2 tsp cayenne (optional)
Salt to taste
recipes.instructions:
Brown the ground beef with the onion and garlic in a skillet, then drain excess fat and transfer to the crock pot.
Add kidney beans, black beans, and crushed tomatoes.
Stir in chili powder, smoked paprika, oregano, and cayenne if using.
Cover and cook on Low for 7 hours, stirring once partway through.
Taste and adjust salt before serving.
Top with shredded cheese or diced onion if desired.

recipes.title: Crock Pot Short Ribs in Red Wine Sauce
recipes.ingredients:
3 lb bone-in beef short ribs
2 tbsp flour
2 tbsp oil
1 onion, sliced
2 carrots, chopped
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 cup dry red wine
1 1/2 cups beef broth
2 tbsp tomato paste
2 sprigs fresh rosemary
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Season short ribs with salt and pepper and dust lightly with flour.
Sear ribs in hot oil in a skillet until browned on all sides, then transfer to the crock pot.
Add onion, carrots, and garlic to the crock pot.
Whisk together red wine, broth, and tomato paste, then pour over the ribs and tuck in rosemary sprigs.
Cover and cook on Low for 8 hours until the meat is fork-tender.
Remove rosemary sprigs, skim excess fat from the sauce, and serve ribs with sauce spooned over top.

recipes.title: Crock Pot Corned Beef and Cabbage
recipes.ingredients:
2 1/2 lb corned beef brisket with spice packet
4 cups beef broth or water
4 small potatoes, halved
3 carrots, cut into chunks
1/2 head cabbage, cut into wedges
1 tbsp brown sugar
recipes.instructions:
Place the corned beef brisket fat-side up in the crock pot and sprinkle with the seasoning packet and brown sugar.
Add broth or water until the brisket is mostly covered.
Add potatoes and carrots around the meat.
Cover and cook on Low for 8 hours.
Add cabbage wedges on top, pushing them into the liquid slightly, and cook 1 more hour until cabbage is tender.
Slice the brisket against the grain and serve with the vegetables.

recipes.title: Crock Pot Swedish Meatballs
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb ground beef
1/2 lb ground pork
1/2 cup breadcrumbs
1/4 cup milk
1 egg
1/4 tsp nutmeg
1 small onion, grated
2 cups beef broth
3 tbsp flour
1 cup sour cream
2 tbsp butter
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Mix ground beef, ground pork, breadcrumbs, milk, egg, nutmeg, grated onion, salt, and pepper, then roll into 1-inch meatballs.
Brown the meatballs in butter in a skillet just until seared, then transfer to the crock pot.
Whisk broth and flour together and pour over the meatballs.
Cover and cook on Low for 4 hours until meatballs are cooked through and sauce has thickened slightly.
Stir in sour cream during the last 15 minutes of cooking.
Serve over egg noodles or mashed potatoes.

recipes.title: Crock Pot BBQ Pulled Pork Sandwiches
recipes.ingredients:
2 1/2 lb pork shoulder
1 tbsp paprika
1 tsp garlic powder
1 tsp onion powder
1 cup barbecue sauce, divided
1/2 cup chicken broth
Salt and pepper to taste
Sandwich buns, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Rub the pork shoulder with paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper.
Place in the crock pot and pour broth and half of the barbecue sauce around it.
Cover and cook on Low for 8 hours until the pork shreds easily.
Remove the pork, shred with two forks, and discard excess fat.
Return shredded pork to the crock pot and stir in the remaining barbecue sauce.
Pile onto buns and serve warm.

recipes.title: Crock Pot Pork Chops with Apples and Onions
recipes.ingredients:
4 bone-in pork chops
2 apples, sliced
1 onion, sliced
1/2 cup chicken broth
2 tbsp brown sugar
1 tsp cinnamon
1 tbsp apple cider vinegar
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Season pork chops with salt and pepper and place in the crock pot.
Layer apple and onion slices over the chops.
Whisk broth, brown sugar, cinnamon, and vinegar, then pour over everything.
Cover and cook on Low for 5 hours until pork is tender.
Spoon the softened apples and onions over the chops when serving.
Drizzle with a little of the cooking liquid before serving.

recipes.title: Crock Pot Ham and White Bean Soup
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups diced cooked ham
1 lb dried great northern beans, soaked overnight and drained
1 onion, diced
2 carrots, sliced
2 celery stalks, sliced
2 cloves garlic, minced
6 cups chicken broth
1 bay leaf
1/2 tsp dried thyme
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Combine ham, soaked beans, onion, carrots, celery, and garlic in the crock pot.
Pour in broth and add the bay leaf and thyme.
Cover and cook on Low for 7 hours until beans are tender.
Remove the bay leaf and mash some of the beans against the side of the pot to thicken the soup slightly.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Ladle into bowls and serve hot.

recipes.title: Crock Pot Kielbasa and Potato Stew
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb kielbasa sausage, sliced
4 potatoes, cubed
1 onion, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
3 cups chicken broth
1 tsp smoked paprika
1 tbsp whole grain mustard
2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Combine kielbasa, potatoes, onion, and garlic in the crock pot.
Pour in broth and stir in smoked paprika and mustard.
Cover and cook on Low for 6 hours until potatoes are fork-tender.
Stir well, mashing a few potato pieces to thicken the broth.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with fresh parsley before serving.

recipes.title: Crock Pot Whole Herb-Roasted Chicken
recipes.ingredients:
1 whole chicken (about 4 lb)
1 lemon, halved
3 cloves garlic
2 tbsp butter, softened
1 tsp dried rosemary
1 tsp dried thyme
1 onion, quartered
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Pat the chicken dry and rub all over with softened butter, rosemary, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Stuff the cavity with lemon halves, garlic cloves, and onion quarters.
Place the chicken breast-side up in the crock pot.
Cover and cook on Low for 5 hours, until a thermometer inserted in the thigh reads 165F.
Carefully remove the chicken and let it rest 10 minutes before carving.
Spoon pan juices over the carved chicken to serve.

recipes.title: Crock Pot Chicken Tortilla Soup
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb boneless chicken thighs
1 can (15 oz) black beans, drained
1 can (14.5 oz) diced tomatoes
1 cup corn kernels
1 onion, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp chili powder
1 tsp smoked paprika
4 cups chicken broth
Tortilla strips, avocado, and lime, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Place chicken thighs, black beans, diced tomatoes, corn, onion, and garlic in the crock pot.
Stir in chili powder and smoked paprika, then pour in the broth.
Cover and cook on Low for 6 hours until chicken is very tender.
Remove chicken, shred it, and return it to the pot; stir to combine.
Taste and adjust seasoning.
Ladle into bowls and top with tortilla strips, avocado, and a squeeze of lime.

recipes.title: Crock Pot Chicken Cacciatore
recipes.ingredients:
4 bone-in chicken thighs
1 onion, sliced
8 oz mushrooms, sliced
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 can (28 oz) crushed tomatoes
1/2 cup dry white wine
1 tsp dried oregano
1 tsp dried basil
Salt and pepper to taste
Chopped fresh parsley, for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Season chicken thighs with salt and pepper and place in the crock pot.
Scatter onion, mushrooms, and garlic over the chicken.
Pour crushed tomatoes and wine over everything and sprinkle with oregano and basil.
Cover and cook on Low for 6 hours until chicken is tender and falling off the bone.
Skim excess fat from the sauce if needed.
Garnish with parsley and serve over pasta or with crusty bread.

recipes.title: Crock Pot Honey Garlic Chicken Thighs
recipes.ingredients:
6 boneless chicken thighs
1/3 cup honey
1/4 cup soy sauce
4 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp rice vinegar
1 tsp grated fresh ginger
1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water
Sliced scallions, for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Place chicken thighs in the crock pot.
Whisk together honey, soy sauce, garlic, vinegar, and ginger, then pour over the chicken.
Cover and cook on Low for 4 hours until chicken is cooked through and tender.
Remove chicken and whisk the cornstarch slurry into the sauce left in the pot.
Cover and cook on High for 10-15 minutes until the sauce thickens, then return chicken to coat.
Garnish with scallions and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Crock Pot Coconut Curry Chicken
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb boneless chicken thighs, cubed
1 can (14 oz) coconut milk
1 onion, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp grated fresh ginger
1 tbsp ground turmeric
1 tbsp ground coriander
1 tsp mild curry powder
1 tbsp tomato paste
2 carrots, sliced
1 cup chopped spinach
Salt to taste
recipes.instructions:
Combine chicken, onion, garlic, ginger, turmeric, coriander, curry powder, tomato paste, and carrots in the crock pot.
Pour in the coconut milk and stir to coat everything evenly.
Cover and cook on Low for 5 hours until chicken and carrots are tender.
Stir in spinach during the last 10 minutes until wilted.
Season with salt to taste.
Serve over steamed rice.
recipes.notes: Built from turmeric, coriander, and ginger for a warm, mild curry flavor.

recipes.title: Crock Pot Turkey Breast with Gravy
recipes.ingredients:
1 boneless turkey breast (about 3 lb)
2 tbsp butter, softened
1 tsp dried sage
1 tsp dried thyme
1 onion, sliced
1 1/2 cups chicken broth
2 tbsp flour
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Rub the turkey breast with softened butter, sage, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Place onion slices in the bottom of the crock pot and set the turkey breast on top.
Pour in 1 cup of the chicken broth.
Cover and cook on Low for 6 hours until the turkey reaches 165F internally.
Remove the turkey and rest it; whisk the remaining broth with flour and stir into the pot juices, cooking on High until thickened into gravy.
Slice the turkey and serve with the gravy.

recipes.title: Crock Pot Turkey and White Bean Chili
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb ground turkey, browned
1 onion, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
2 cans (15 oz each) white beans, drained
1 can (4 oz) diced green chiles
3 cups chicken broth
1 tbsp chili powder
1 tsp dried oregano
1/2 tsp smoked paprika
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Brown the ground turkey with onion and garlic in a skillet, then transfer to the crock pot.
Add white beans, green chiles, and chicken broth.
Stir in chili powder, oregano, and smoked paprika.
Cover and cook on Low for 6 hours, mashing a few beans against the side to thicken.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve with shredded cheese and a dollop of sour cream if desired.

recipes.title: Crock Pot Vegetable Beef Soup
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb beef stew meat, cubed
1 tbsp oil
3 carrots, sliced
2 celery stalks, sliced
1 onion, diced
2 potatoes, cubed
1 cup green beans, trimmed and cut
1 can (14.5 oz) diced tomatoes
6 cups beef broth
1 tsp dried thyme
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Brown the beef in oil in a skillet, then transfer to the crock pot.
Add carrots, celery, onion, potatoes, and green beans.
Pour in diced tomatoes and beef broth, then stir in thyme.
Cover and cook on Low for 7 hours until beef and vegetables are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Ladle into bowls and serve hot.

recipes.title: Crock Pot Minestrone Soup
recipes.ingredients:
1 onion, diced
2 carrots, sliced
2 celery stalks, sliced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 zucchini, diced
1 can (15 oz) kidney beans, drained
1 can (28 oz) diced tomatoes
5 cups vegetable broth
1 tsp dried basil
1 tsp dried oregano
1 cup small pasta, such as ditalini
Parmesan cheese, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Combine onion, carrots, celery, garlic, zucchini, kidney beans, and diced tomatoes in the crock pot.
Pour in vegetable broth and stir in basil and oregano.
Cover and cook on Low for 5 hours until vegetables are tender.
Stir in pasta during the last 20-30 minutes of cooking, until al dente.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Ladle into bowls and top with grated Parmesan.

recipes.title: Crock Pot Lentil Soup
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups dried brown lentils, rinsed
1 onion, diced
2 carrots, diced
2 celery stalks, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 can (14.5 oz) diced tomatoes
6 cups vegetable broth
1 tsp dried thyme
1 bay leaf
2 tbsp lemon juice
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Combine lentils, onion, carrots, celery, garlic, and diced tomatoes in the crock pot.
Pour in vegetable broth and add thyme and bay leaf.
Cover and cook on Low for 6 hours until lentils are tender.
Remove the bay leaf and stir in lemon juice.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Ladle into bowls and serve warm.

recipes.title: Crock Pot French Onion Soup
recipes.ingredients:
4 large onions, thinly sliced
3 tbsp butter
2 cloves garlic, minced
6 cups beef broth
1/2 cup dry sherry or white wine
1 tsp dried thyme
1 bay leaf
Baguette slices, toasted
1 1/2 cups shredded Gruyere cheese
recipes.instructions:
Toss the sliced onions with melted butter and place them in the crock pot.
Cover and cook on Low for 6 hours, stirring once, until the onions are deeply caramelized.
Add garlic, broth, sherry, thyme, and bay leaf, then cook 2 more hours on Low.
Remove the bay leaf and season with salt and pepper.
Ladle soup into oven-safe bowls, top with a toasted baguette slice and shredded Gruyere.
Broil for 2-3 minutes until the cheese is bubbly and golden before serving.

recipes.title: Crock Pot Beef Stroganoff
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb beef stew meat, cubed
1 onion, diced
8 oz mushrooms, sliced
2 cloves garlic, minced
2 cups beef broth
1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
1 tbsp tomato paste
1 cup sour cream
2 tbsp flour
Egg noodles, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Combine beef, onion, mushrooms, and garlic in the crock pot.
Whisk together broth, Worcestershire sauce, and tomato paste, then pour over the beef.
Cover and cook on Low for 6 hours until the beef is very tender.
Whisk sour cream and flour together, then stir into the pot; cook on High for 15 minutes until thickened.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve over cooked egg noodles.

recipes.title: Crock Pot Carne Guisada
recipes.ingredients:
2 lb beef chuck, cubed
2 tbsp flour
1 tbsp oil
1 onion, diced
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 can (10 oz) diced tomatoes with green chiles
2 cups beef broth
1 tsp Mexican oregano
1 tsp chili powder
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Toss beef with flour and brown in oil in a skillet, then transfer to the crock pot.
Add onion, garlic, and diced tomatoes with green chiles.
Pour in beef broth and stir in oregano and chili powder.
Cover and cook on Low for 7 hours until beef is fork-tender and the sauce has thickened.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve with warm tortillas and rice.

recipes.title: Crock Pot Chicken Enchilada Soup
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb boneless chicken breasts
1 can (10 oz) red enchilada sauce
1 can (15 oz) black beans, drained
1 cup corn kernels
1 onion, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
4 cups chicken broth
1 tsp smoked paprika
1/2 tsp dried oregano
Shredded cheese and tortilla strips, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Place chicken breasts, enchilada sauce, black beans, corn, onion, and garlic in the crock pot.
Pour in the chicken broth and stir in the smoked paprika and oregano.
Cover and cook on Low for 6 hours until the chicken is very tender.
Remove chicken, shred it, and return to the pot, stirring to combine.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Ladle into bowls and top with shredded cheese and tortilla strips.

recipes.title: Crock Pot White Chicken Chili
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb boneless chicken breasts
2 cans (15 oz each) great northern beans, drained
1 can (4 oz) diced green chiles
1 onion, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
4 cups chicken broth
1 tsp dried oregano
1/2 tsp coriander
1/2 cup sour cream
1/2 cup shredded Monterey Jack cheese
recipes.instructions:
Place chicken, beans, green chiles, onion, and garlic in the crock pot.
Pour in broth and stir in oregano and coriander.
Cover and cook on Low for 6 hours until chicken is very tender.
Remove chicken, shred it, and return to the pot.
Stir in sour cream and shredded cheese until melted and creamy.
Ladle into bowls and serve warm.

recipes.title: Crock Pot Italian Sausage with Onions and Mushrooms
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb Italian sausage links
2 onions, sliced
8 oz mushrooms, sliced
1 can (14.5 oz) diced tomatoes
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tsp dried Italian seasoning
1/2 cup chicken broth
Salt and pepper to taste
Hoagie rolls, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Place sausage links, onions, and mushrooms in the crock pot.
Add diced tomatoes, garlic, Italian seasoning, and broth.
Cover and cook on Low for 5 hours until sausages are cooked through and onions are soft.
Slice sausages if desired and stir back into the sauce.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve on hoagie rolls with the onions, mushrooms, and sauce spooned on top.

recipes.title: Crock Pot Beef Barbacoa
recipes.ingredients:
2 1/2 lb beef chuck roast
4 cloves garlic, minced
1/4 cup lime juice
2 tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 chipotle pepper in adobo, minced
1 tbsp adobo sauce
1 tsp dried oregano
1/2 tsp ground cloves
1 cup beef broth
Salt to taste
recipes.instructions:
Place the chuck roast in the crock pot.
Whisk garlic, lime juice, vinegar, chipotle pepper, adobo sauce, oregano, and cloves together and pour over the beef.
Add the beef broth around the roast.
Cover and cook on Low for 8 hours until the meat shreds very easily.
Shred the beef directly in the cooking liquid and stir to coat.
Serve in tacos, burritos, or rice bowls.

recipes.title: Crock Pot Cuban Mojo Pulled Pork
recipes.ingredients:
2 1/2 lb pork shoulder
1/2 cup orange juice
1/4 cup lime juice
6 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp dried oregano
1 tsp ground coriander
1 onion, sliced
2 tbsp olive oil
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Rub the pork shoulder with salt, pepper, oregano, and coriander.
Place onion slices in the bottom of the crock pot and set the pork on top.
Whisk orange juice, lime juice, garlic, and olive oil together and pour over the pork.
Cover and cook on Low for 8 hours until the pork shreds easily.
Shred the pork and mix it with the flavorful cooking liquid and softened onions.
Serve with rice and black beans.

recipes.title: Crock Pot Creamy Chicken Alfredo Pasta
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb boneless chicken breasts, cubed
2 cloves garlic, minced
2 cups chicken broth
1 cup heavy cream
1 tsp Italian seasoning
8 oz penne pasta
1 cup grated Parmesan cheese
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Combine chicken, garlic, broth, and Italian seasoning in the crock pot.
Cover and cook on Low for 3 1/2 hours until chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the heavy cream and uncooked pasta.
Cover and cook on High for 25-30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until pasta is tender.
Stir in Parmesan cheese until melted and creamy.
Season with salt and pepper and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Crock Pot Sloppy Joes
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb ground beef, browned and drained
1 onion, diced
1 cup ketchup
2 tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
1 tbsp yellow mustard
1/2 cup water
Salt and pepper to taste
Hamburger buns, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Brown the ground beef with onion in a skillet, then drain and transfer to the crock pot.
Stir in ketchup, brown sugar, Worcestershire sauce, mustard, and water.
Cover and cook on Low for 4 hours, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Spoon the mixture onto hamburger buns.
Serve warm with chips or a side salad.

recipes.title: Crock Pot Old-Fashioned Meatloaf
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb ground beef
1/2 cup breadcrumbs
1/4 cup milk
1 egg
1 small onion, finely diced
1 tsp garlic powder
1/2 cup ketchup, divided
2 tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Mix ground beef, breadcrumbs, milk, egg, onion, garlic powder, half the ketchup, salt, and pepper until combined.
Shape into a loaf and place on a foil sling in the crock pot for easy removal.
Whisk remaining ketchup with brown sugar and Worcestershire sauce and spread over the top of the loaf.
Cover and cook on Low for 5 hours, or until the meatloaf reaches 160F internally.
Let rest 10 minutes before lifting out with the foil sling.
Slice and serve warm.

recipes.title: Crock Pot Chicken Noodle Soup
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb boneless chicken thighs
3 carrots, sliced
2 celery stalks, sliced
1 onion, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
6 cups chicken broth
1 tsp dried thyme
1 bay leaf
2 cups egg noodles
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Combine chicken thighs, carrots, celery, onion, and garlic in the crock pot.
Pour in broth and add thyme and bay leaf.
Cover and cook on Low for 6 hours until chicken is very tender.
Remove chicken, shred it, and return to the pot, discarding the bay leaf.
Stir in egg noodles and cook on High for 15-20 minutes until tender.
Season with salt and pepper and serve hot.

recipes.title: Crock Pot Beef and Mushroom Stew
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb beef stew meat, cubed
1 tbsp oil
12 oz mushrooms, quartered
1 onion, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
3 cups beef broth
2 tbsp tomato paste
1 tsp dried thyme
2 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Brown the beef in oil in a skillet, then transfer to the crock pot.
Add mushrooms, onion, and garlic.
Whisk broth and tomato paste together, stir in thyme, and pour over the beef mixture.
Cover and cook on Low for 7 hours until beef is tender.
Stir in the cornstarch slurry and cook on High for 15 minutes until the stew thickens.
Season with salt and pepper before serving.

recipes.title: Crock Pot Brown Sugar Glazed Ham
recipes.ingredients:
1 boneless ham (about 3 lb), pre-cooked
1/2 cup brown sugar
2 tbsp Dijon mustard
1/4 cup pineapple juice
1/4 tsp ground cloves
1/2 tsp cinnamon
recipes.instructions:
Place the ham in the crock pot.
Whisk brown sugar, Dijon mustard, pineapple juice, cloves, and cinnamon together to make a glaze.
Pour the glaze over the ham, spreading to coat.
Cover and cook on Low for 4 hours, basting with the glaze once or twice, until heated through.
Let rest 10 minutes before slicing.
Spoon extra glaze over the slices when serving.

recipes.title: Crock Pot Turkey Meatball Soup
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb ground turkey
1/3 cup breadcrumbs
1 egg
2 cloves garlic, minced (divided)
1 onion, diced
2 carrots, sliced
2 celery stalks, sliced
6 cups chicken broth
1 cup baby spinach
1 tsp dried oregano
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Mix ground turkey, breadcrumbs, egg, half the garlic, salt, and pepper, then roll into small meatballs.
Place onion, carrots, celery, remaining garlic, and broth in the crock pot; stir in oregano.
Gently drop the meatballs into the broth.
Cover and cook on Low for 5 hours until meatballs are cooked through and vegetables are tender.
Stir in spinach during the last 10 minutes until wilted.
Season with salt and pepper and serve hot.

recipes.title: Crock Pot Vegetable Chickpea Curry
recipes.ingredients:
2 cans (15 oz each) chickpeas, drained
1 can (14 oz) coconut milk
1 onion, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp grated fresh ginger
2 potatoes, cubed
1 cup chopped cauliflower florets
1 tbsp ground turmeric
1 tbsp ground coriander
1/2 tsp mustard seed
1 cup chopped spinach
Salt to taste
recipes.instructions:
Combine chickpeas, onion, garlic, ginger, potatoes, cauliflower, turmeric, coriander, and mustard seed in the crock pot.
Pour in coconut milk and stir to combine.
Cover and cook on Low for 5 hours until vegetables are tender.
Stir in spinach during the last 10 minutes until wilted.
Season with salt to taste.
Serve over steamed rice.
recipes.notes: Built from turmeric, coriander, and mustard seed for a warm, mild curry flavor.

recipes.title: Crock Pot Black Bean Soup
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb dried black beans, soaked overnight and drained
1 onion, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 carrot, diced
1 can (14.5 oz) diced tomatoes
6 cups vegetable broth
1 tsp dried oregano
1 tsp smoked paprika
2 tbsp lime juice
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Combine soaked black beans, onion, garlic, carrot, and diced tomatoes in the crock pot.
Pour in vegetable broth and stir in oregano and smoked paprika.
Cover and cook on Low for 6 hours until the beans are very tender.
Puree about a third of the soup with an immersion blender for a thicker texture, if desired.
Stir in lime juice and season with salt and pepper.
Ladle into bowls and serve warm.

recipes.title: Crock Pot Chicken Fajita Bowls
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb boneless chicken thighs
1 onion, sliced
1 poblano pepper, sliced
1 zucchini, sliced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp chili powder
1 tsp smoked paprika
1 tsp dried oregano
1/4 cup chicken broth
2 tbsp lime juice
Cooked rice, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Combine chicken, onion, poblano, zucchini, and garlic in the crock pot.
Sprinkle chili powder, smoked paprika, and oregano over everything, then pour in the broth.
Cover and cook on Low for 5 hours until chicken is tender.
Remove chicken, shred or slice it, and return to the pot along with the vegetables.
Stir in lime juice.
Serve over rice with your favorite toppings.

recipes.title: Crock Pot Apple Cinnamon Steel-Cut Oats
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup steel-cut oats
4 cups milk
2 apples, diced
2 tbsp brown sugar
1 tsp cinnamon
1/4 tsp nutmeg
1/4 tsp salt
1 tsp vanilla extract
recipes.instructions:
Grease the crock pot insert lightly to prevent sticking.
Combine oats, milk, diced apples, brown sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt in the crock pot.
Cover and cook on Low for 7 hours, or overnight, until oats are soft and creamy.
Stir in vanilla extract before serving.
Spoon into bowls and add a splash of milk if desired.
Top with extra apple slices or a drizzle of maple syrup.

recipes.title: Crock Pot Sausage and Potato Breakfast Casserole
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb breakfast sausage, browned and crumbled
4 cups frozen hash browns
1 onion, diced
8 eggs, beaten
1 cup milk
1 1/2 cups shredded cheddar cheese
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Grease the crock pot and layer in half the hash browns.
Sprinkle half the sausage, onion, and cheese over the hash browns, then repeat the layers.
Whisk eggs and milk together with salt and pepper, then pour evenly over the layered ingredients.
Cover and cook on Low for 4 hours, or until the eggs are set in the center.
Let rest 10 minutes before scooping to serve.
Garnish with extra cheese or hot sauce if desired.

recipes.title: Crock Pot Cheesy Chicken and Potato Casserole
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb boneless chicken thighs, cubed
5 potatoes, sliced
1 onion, diced
2 cups chicken broth
1 cup heavy cream
2 cups shredded cheddar cheese
1 tsp garlic powder
1 tsp smoked paprika
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Layer potatoes, onion, and chicken in the crock pot.
Whisk broth and heavy cream together with garlic powder and smoked paprika, then pour over everything.
Cover and cook on Low for 6 hours until potatoes and chicken are tender.
Stir in half the cheese until melted.
Sprinkle remaining cheese on top, cover, and cook 10 more minutes until melted.
Season with salt and pepper and serve hot.

recipes.title: Crock Pot Chocolate Lava Cake
recipes.ingredients:
1 box chocolate cake mix plus ingredients called for on the box
1 box instant chocolate pudding mix
2 cups milk
1/2 cup chocolate chips
Whipped cream, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Prepare the cake batter according to the package directions and pour it into a greased crock pot.
Whisk the pudding mix with milk until smooth, then pour it evenly over the cake batter without stirring.
Sprinkle chocolate chips over the top.
Cover and cook on Low for 2 hours, until the top is set but the inside is molten and fudgy.
Let cool for 10 minutes before scooping.
Serve warm with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Crock Pot Cinnamon Apple Crisp
recipes.ingredients:
6 apples, peeled and sliced
1/3 cup sugar
1 tsp cinnamon
1 tbsp lemon juice
1 cup rolled oats
1/2 cup flour
1/3 cup brown sugar
1/2 tsp cinnamon
6 tbsp cold butter, cubed
recipes.instructions:
Toss the apple slices with sugar, cinnamon, and lemon juice, then spread in the bottom of the crock pot.
Combine oats, flour, brown sugar, and cinnamon in a bowl, then cut in the cold butter until crumbly.
Sprinkle the oat topping evenly over the apples.
Cover and cook on Low for 3 hours until the apples are tender and the topping is set.
Remove the lid for the last 20 minutes to help the topping firm up.
Serve warm, topped with vanilla ice cream if desired.

recipes.title: Crock Pot Cherry Cobbler
recipes.ingredients:
2 cans (15 oz each) cherry pie filling
1 box yellow cake mix
4 tbsp butter, melted
1/2 tsp almond extract
1/4 cup sliced almonds (optional)
recipes.instructions:
Pour the cherry pie filling into the crock pot and stir in the almond extract.
Sprinkle the dry cake mix evenly over the cherries without stirring.
Drizzle the melted butter over the cake mix layer.
Sprinkle sliced almonds on top if using.
Cover and cook on Low for 3 hours until the topping is set and lightly golden.
Serve warm with vanilla ice cream.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Beef Stew
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb beef stew meat, cubed
2 tbsp oil
1 onion, diced
3 carrots, chunked
3 potatoes, cubed
3 cups beef broth
2 tbsp tomato paste
1 tsp dried thyme
2 tbsp flour mixed with 2 tbsp water
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Set Instant Pot to Saute and brown the beef in oil in batches, then remove and set aside.
Saute the onion for 2 minutes, scraping up any browned bits.
Return beef to the pot with carrots, potatoes, broth, tomato paste, and thyme.
Seal the lid and set to Manual/High Pressure for 25 minutes, then let it natural release for 10 minutes before quick releasing the rest.
Set to Saute, stir in the flour slurry, and simmer 3-5 minutes until thickened.
Season with salt and pepper and serve hot.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Pot Roast with Gravy
recipes.ingredients:
2 1/2 lb chuck roast
2 tbsp oil
1 onion, sliced
3 carrots, chunked
3 potatoes, quartered
2 cups beef broth
1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
1 tsp dried rosemary
3 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 3 tbsp water
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Set Instant Pot to Saute, season the roast with salt and pepper, and sear on all sides in oil.
Add onion, carrots, potatoes, broth, Worcestershire sauce, and rosemary around the roast.
Seal the lid and set to Manual/High Pressure for 55 minutes.
Let the pressure release naturally for 15 minutes, then quick release any remaining pressure.
Remove the roast and vegetables; set the pot to Saute and whisk in the cornstarch slurry to thicken the gravy.
Slice or shred the roast and serve with vegetables and gravy.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Beef and Broccoli
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb flank steak, thinly sliced
1/3 cup soy sauce
3 tbsp brown sugar
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 tsp grated fresh ginger
3/4 cup beef broth
1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water
4 cups broccoli florets
Sesame seeds, for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Combine steak, soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, and beef broth in the Instant Pot.
Seal the lid and set to Manual/High Pressure for 8 minutes.
Quick release the pressure, then set to Saute and stir in the cornstarch slurry until thickened.
Add broccoli florets, cover (not sealed), and let steam 3-4 minutes until crisp-tender.
Stir everything together to coat in the sauce.
Garnish with sesame seeds and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Mongolian Beef
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb flank steak, sliced thin
2 tbsp oil
4 cloves garlic, minced
1 tsp grated fresh ginger
1/2 cup soy sauce
1/2 cup brown sugar
1/2 cup water
2 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water
Sliced scallions, for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Set Instant Pot to Saute and brown the steak slices in oil for 2 minutes.
Add garlic, ginger, soy sauce, brown sugar, and water; stir to combine.
Seal the lid and set to Manual/High Pressure for 5 minutes, then quick release.
Set to Saute and stir in the cornstarch slurry, simmering until the sauce thickens.
Stir the beef to coat evenly in the glossy sauce.
Garnish with scallions and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Korean Beef Bowls
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb ground beef
4 cloves garlic, minced
1 tsp grated fresh ginger
1/3 cup soy sauce
1/4 cup brown sugar
1 tbsp sesame oil
1/4 tsp red pepper flakes
2 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water
Sliced scallions and sesame seeds, for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Set Instant Pot to Saute and brown the ground beef, breaking it apart, then drain excess fat.
Add garlic, ginger, soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, and red pepper flakes.
Seal the lid and set to Manual/High Pressure for 5 minutes, then quick release.
Set to Saute and stir in the cornstarch slurry, simmering 2-3 minutes until thickened.
Stir to coat the beef in the sauce.
Serve over rice, garnished with scallions and sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Shredded Beef Tacos
recipes.ingredients:
2 lb beef chuck roast, cubed
1 tbsp oil
1 onion, diced
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 can (10 oz) diced tomatoes with green chiles
1 cup beef broth
1 tbsp chili powder
1 tsp dried oregano
Corn tortillas, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Set Instant Pot to Saute and brown the beef in oil in batches.
Add onion and garlic, sauteing 2 minutes.
Stir in diced tomatoes with green chiles, broth, chili powder, and oregano.
Seal the lid and set to Manual/High Pressure for 40 minutes, then natural release 15 minutes.
Shred the beef directly in the pot and stir to combine with the sauce.
Serve in warm tortillas with your favorite toppings.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Pork Carnitas
recipes.ingredients:
2 1/2 lb pork shoulder, cubed
1 onion, quartered
4 cloves garlic
1 orange, juiced
2 tbsp lime juice
1 tsp dried oregano
1 tsp smoked paprika
1 cup chicken broth
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Season the pork cubes with salt, pepper, oregano, and smoked paprika, then place in the Instant Pot.
Add onion, garlic, orange juice, lime juice, and chicken broth.
Seal the lid and set to Manual/High Pressure for 45 minutes, then natural release for 15 minutes.
Shred the pork with two forks directly in the flavorful liquid.
For crispy edges, spread shredded pork on a sheet pan and broil 3-5 minutes until browned at the edges.
Serve in tacos or over rice.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Pork Tenderloin with Apples
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb pork tenderloin
2 tbsp oil
2 apples, sliced
1 onion, sliced
1/2 cup apple cider
1/2 cup chicken broth
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tsp dried thyme
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Season the pork tenderloin with salt, pepper, and thyme.
Set Instant Pot to Saute and sear the tenderloin in oil on all sides, then remove.
Add apples, onion, cider, broth, and mustard to the pot, scraping up browned bits.
Return the tenderloin to the pot, seal the lid, and set to Manual/High Pressure for 8 minutes.
Natural release for 5 minutes, then quick release the rest.
Slice the pork and serve with the apples, onions, and pan sauce.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Pulled Pork
recipes.ingredients:
2 1/2 lb pork shoulder, cut into large chunks
1 tbsp paprika
1 tsp garlic powder
1 tsp onion powder
1 cup chicken broth
1 cup barbecue sauce, divided
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Rub the pork with paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper.
Place the pork in the Instant Pot with the broth and half the barbecue sauce.
Seal the lid and set to Manual/High Pressure for 55 minutes, then natural release for 15 minutes.
Shred the pork with two forks directly in the pot.
Stir in the remaining barbecue sauce.
Pile onto buns or serve over rice.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Baby Back Ribs
recipes.ingredients:
1 rack baby back ribs, cut in half to fit
1 tbsp paprika
1 tsp garlic powder
1 tsp onion powder
1 cup water or apple juice
1 cup barbecue sauce
recipes.instructions:
Rub the ribs all over with paprika, garlic powder, and onion powder.
Pour the water or apple juice into the Instant Pot and place a trivet inside; set the ribs on the trivet, standing them on their sides.
Seal the lid and set to Manual/High Pressure for 24 minutes, then natural release for 10 minutes.
Carefully remove the ribs and brush generously with barbecue sauce.
Broil in the oven for 3-5 minutes until the sauce caramelizes, or use an air fryer basket if available.
Slice between the bones and serve.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Whole Chicken
recipes.ingredients:
1 whole chicken (about 4 lb)
1 cup chicken broth
1 lemon, halved
4 cloves garlic
1 tsp dried rosemary
1 tsp dried thyme
2 tbsp butter, softened
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Rub the chicken all over with softened butter, rosemary, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Stuff the cavity with lemon halves and garlic cloves.
Pour the broth into the Instant Pot and place a trivet inside; set the chicken on the trivet breast-side up.
Seal the lid and set to Manual/High Pressure for 25 minutes (about 6 minutes per pound), then natural release for 10 minutes.
Check that the internal temperature reaches 165F; if needed, broil briefly to crisp the skin.
Carve and serve with the pan juices.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Butter Chicken
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb boneless chicken thighs, cubed
2 tbsp butter
1 onion, diced
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp grated fresh ginger
1 can (14.5 oz) tomato sauce
1 tsp smoked paprika
1 tsp ground coriander
1/2 tsp turmeric
1/2 cup heavy cream
Salt to taste
recipes.instructions:
Set Instant Pot to Saute and melt the butter, then cook onion, garlic, and ginger until fragrant.
Add chicken, tomato sauce, smoked paprika, coriander, and turmeric, stirring well.
Seal the lid and set to Manual/High Pressure for 8 minutes, then quick release.
Set to Saute and stir in the heavy cream, simmering 2-3 minutes until slightly thickened.
Season with salt to taste.
Serve over rice with warm naan.
recipes.notes: Built from paprika, coriander, and turmeric for a warm, mild flavor.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Chicken and Wild Rice Soup
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb boneless chicken breasts
1 cup wild rice blend
1 onion, diced
2 carrots, sliced
2 celery stalks, sliced
2 cloves garlic, minced
6 cups chicken broth
1 tsp dried thyme
1/2 cup heavy cream
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Combine chicken, wild rice, onion, carrots, celery, garlic, broth, and thyme in the Instant Pot.
Seal the lid and set to Manual/High Pressure for 25 minutes, then natural release for 10 minutes.
Remove the chicken, shred it, and return to the pot.
Set to Saute and stir in the heavy cream, warming through for 2-3 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Ladle into bowls and serve hot.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Chicken Tortellini Soup
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb boneless chicken breasts
1 onion, diced
2 carrots, sliced
2 celery stalks, sliced
2 cloves garlic, minced
6 cups chicken broth
1 tsp dried Italian seasoning
2 cups cheese tortellini
2 cups baby spinach
Grated Parmesan, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Combine chicken, onion, carrots, celery, garlic, broth, and Italian seasoning in the Instant Pot.
Seal the lid and set to Manual/High Pressure for 10 minutes, then quick release.
Remove the chicken, shred it, and return to the pot.
Set to Saute, stir in the tortellini, and simmer 4-5 minutes until tender.
Stir in spinach until wilted.
Ladle into bowls and top with Parmesan.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Salsa Verde Chicken
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb boneless chicken breasts
1 1/2 cups salsa verde
1 onion, diced
1 tsp dried oregano
1/2 tsp garlic powder
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Place chicken breasts in the Instant Pot and pour salsa verde over them.
Add onion, oregano, and garlic powder.
Seal the lid and set to Manual/High Pressure for 10 minutes, then natural release for 5 minutes.
Shred the chicken directly in the pot and stir into the sauce.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve in tacos, burrito bowls, or over rice.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Chicken Fajita Pasta
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb boneless chicken breasts, sliced
1 onion, sliced
1 poblano pepper, sliced
2 cups chicken broth
1 can (14.5 oz) diced tomatoes
8 oz penne pasta
1 tbsp chili powder
1 tsp smoked paprika
1/2 cup shredded cheddar cheese
recipes.instructions:
Combine chicken, onion, poblano, broth, diced tomatoes, and uncooked pasta in the Instant Pot.
Sprinkle in chili powder and smoked paprika, and stir to combine, making sure pasta is submerged.
Seal the lid and set to Manual/High Pressure for 5 minutes, then quick release.
Stir well; the sauce will thicken as it sits for a minute.
Sprinkle cheese over the top and let it melt.
Serve hot, garnished with cilantro if desired.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Turkey Breast
recipes.ingredients:
1 boneless turkey breast (about 3 lb)
2 tbsp butter, softened
1 tsp dried sage
1 tsp dried thyme
1 cup chicken broth
1 onion, quartered
2 tbsp flour mixed with 2 tbsp water
recipes.instructions:
Rub the turkey breast with softened butter, sage, and thyme.
Pour broth into the Instant Pot and add the onion; place the turkey on a trivet inside.
Seal the lid and set to Manual/High Pressure for 22 minutes, then natural release for 10 minutes.
Check the internal temperature reaches 165F; remove and rest the turkey.
Set to Saute and whisk the flour slurry into the broth to make gravy.
Slice the turkey and serve with the gravy.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Turkey Chili
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb ground turkey
1 onion, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 can (15 oz) kidney beans, drained
1 can (15 oz) black beans, drained
1 can (28 oz) crushed tomatoes
2 tbsp chili powder
1 tsp smoked paprika
1 tsp dried oregano
Salt to taste
recipes.instructions:
Set Instant Pot to Saute and brown the ground turkey with onion and garlic, breaking it apart as it cooks.
Add kidney beans, black beans, crushed tomatoes, chili powder, smoked paprika, and oregano.
Seal the lid and set to Manual/High Pressure for 12 minutes, then quick release.
Stir well and season with salt to taste.
Simmer uncovered on Saute for a few minutes if a thicker consistency is desired.
Serve with shredded cheese and diced onion.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Beef Bourguignon
recipes.ingredients:
2 lb beef chuck, cubed
4 slices bacon, chopped
1 onion, diced
2 carrots, sliced
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 1/2 cups dry red wine
1 1/2 cups beef broth
2 tbsp tomato paste
1 tsp dried thyme
8 oz mushrooms, quartered
2 tbsp flour mixed with 2 tbsp water
recipes.instructions:
Set Instant Pot to Saute and cook the bacon until crisp; remove and set aside, leaving the fat in the pot.
Brown the beef in batches in the bacon fat, then remove.
Saute onion, carrots, and garlic for 2 minutes, then return the beef to the pot.
Add wine, broth, tomato paste, and thyme; seal the lid and set to Manual/High Pressure for 35 minutes, then natural release 15 minutes.
Set to Saute, stir in mushrooms and the flour slurry, and simmer 5 minutes until thickened.
Stir in the reserved bacon and serve over mashed potatoes or egg noodles.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Vegetable Barley Soup
recipes.ingredients:
2/3 cup pearl barley
1 onion, diced
2 carrots, sliced
2 celery stalks, sliced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 zucchini, diced
1 can (14.5 oz) diced tomatoes
6 cups vegetable broth
1 tsp dried thyme
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Combine barley, onion, carrots, celery, garlic, zucchini, diced tomatoes, and broth in the Instant Pot.
Stir in thyme.
Seal the lid and set to Manual/High Pressure for 20 minutes, then natural release for 10 minutes.
Stir well; the soup will thicken slightly as it sits.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Ladle into bowls and serve hot.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Tuscan White Bean Soup
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb dried cannellini beans, rinsed
1 onion, diced
2 carrots, diced
2 celery stalks, diced
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 can (14.5 oz) diced tomatoes
6 cups vegetable broth
1 tsp dried rosemary
2 cups chopped kale
Grated Parmesan, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Combine beans, onion, carrots, celery, garlic, diced tomatoes, broth, and rosemary in the Instant Pot.
Seal the lid and set to Manual/High Pressure for 25 minutes, then natural release for 15 minutes.
Stir in the chopped kale until wilted from the residual heat.
Mash a few beans against the side of the pot to thicken the broth slightly.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Ladle into bowls and top with Parmesan.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Lentil Curry
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups dried red lentils, rinsed
1 onion, diced
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp grated fresh ginger
1 can (14 oz) coconut milk
1 can (14.5 oz) diced tomatoes
1 tbsp ground turmeric
1 tbsp ground coriander
1/2 tsp fenugreek seeds
2 cups baby spinach
Salt to taste
recipes.instructions:
Combine lentils, onion, garlic, ginger, coconut milk, diced tomatoes, turmeric, coriander, and fenugreek in the Instant Pot.
Seal the lid and set to Manual/High Pressure for 8 minutes, then quick release.
Stir well; the curry will thicken as the lentils absorb liquid.
Stir in spinach until wilted from residual heat.
Season with salt to taste.
Serve over rice or with warm flatbread.
recipes.notes: Built from turmeric, coriander, and fenugreek for a warm, mild curry flavor.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Chana Masala
recipes.ingredients:
2 cans (15 oz each) chickpeas, drained
1 onion, diced
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp grated fresh ginger
1 can (14.5 oz) diced tomatoes
1 tsp ground coriander
1/2 tsp turmeric
1/4 tsp ground cinnamon
1/4 tsp ground cardamom
2 tbsp tomato paste
Chopped cilantro, for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Combine chickpeas, onion, garlic, ginger, diced tomatoes, coriander, turmeric, cinnamon, cardamom, and tomato paste in the Instant Pot.
Seal the lid and set to Manual/High Pressure for 6 minutes, then quick release.
Set to Saute and simmer uncovered for 3-4 minutes to thicken slightly, mashing a few chickpeas against the side.
Season with salt to taste.
Garnish with fresh cilantro.
Serve with rice or naan.
recipes.notes: Built from coriander, cinnamon, and cardamom for a warm, mild spice blend.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Chicken and Sausage Jambalaya
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb boneless chicken thighs, cubed
8 oz andouille sausage, sliced
1 onion, diced
2 celery stalks, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 1/2 cups long-grain rice
1 can (14.5 oz) diced tomatoes
2 1/2 cups chicken broth
1 tsp smoked paprika
1 tsp dried thyme
1/2 tsp cayenne
recipes.instructions:
Set Instant Pot to Saute and brown the sausage slices, then remove and set aside.
Saute chicken, onion, celery, and garlic for 3 minutes.
Stir in rice, diced tomatoes, broth, smoked paprika, thyme, and cayenne, then return the sausage to the pot.
Seal the lid and set to Manual/High Pressure for 6 minutes, then natural release for 10 minutes.
Fluff with a fork before serving.
Garnish with sliced scallions if desired.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Beef and Rice Skillet
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb ground beef, browned and drained
1 onion, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 1/2 cups long-grain rice
1 can (14.5 oz) diced tomatoes
2 1/2 cups beef broth
1 tsp paprika
1 tsp dried oregano
1 cup shredded cheddar cheese
recipes.instructions:
Set Instant Pot to Saute and brown the ground beef with onion and garlic, then drain excess fat.
Stir in rice, diced tomatoes, broth, paprika, and oregano.
Seal the lid and set to Manual/High Pressure for 6 minutes, then natural release for 10 minutes.
Fluff the rice with a fork and stir everything together.
Sprinkle cheese over the top and let it melt from residual heat.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Chicken Adobo
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb boneless chicken thighs
1/2 cup soy sauce
1/3 cup white vinegar
4 cloves garlic, minced
1 bay leaf
1/2 tsp black peppercorns
1 tbsp brown sugar
2 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water
recipes.instructions:
Combine chicken, soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, bay leaf, peppercorns, and brown sugar in the Instant Pot.
Seal the lid and set to Manual/High Pressure for 10 minutes, then natural release for 10 minutes.
Remove the chicken and bay leaf; set the pot to Saute.
Stir the cornstarch slurry into the sauce and simmer until thickened.
Return the chicken to the pot and coat in the sauce.
Serve over steamed rice.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Sausage and Potato Soup
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb smoked sausage, sliced
4 potatoes, cubed
1 onion, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
5 cups chicken broth
1 tsp smoked paprika
1/2 cup heavy cream
2 cups chopped kale
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Set Instant Pot to Saute and brown the sausage slices for 3-4 minutes.
Add potatoes, onion, garlic, broth, and smoked paprika.
Seal the lid and set to Manual/High Pressure for 8 minutes, then quick release.
Set to Saute, stir in heavy cream and kale, and simmer 2-3 minutes until the kale wilts.
Mash a few potato pieces against the side to thicken slightly.
Season with salt and pepper and serve hot.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Loaded Potato Soup
recipes.ingredients:
5 potatoes, cubed
1 onion, diced
3 cloves garlic, minced
4 cups chicken broth
1 cup heavy cream
1 1/2 cups shredded cheddar cheese
6 slices bacon, cooked and crumbled
Sliced scallions, for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Combine potatoes, onion, garlic, and broth in the Instant Pot.
Seal the lid and set to Manual/High Pressure for 10 minutes, then quick release.
Mash some of the potatoes directly in the pot with a potato masher for a thicker texture.
Set to Saute and stir in heavy cream and cheddar cheese until melted.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Top with crumbled bacon and scallions before serving.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Broccoli Cheddar Soup
recipes.ingredients:
4 cups broccoli florets
1 onion, diced
2 carrots, grated
2 cloves garlic, minced
3 cups vegetable broth
1 cup heavy cream
2 cups shredded cheddar cheese
2 tbsp flour
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Combine broccoli, onion, carrots, garlic, and broth in the Instant Pot.
Seal the lid and set to Manual/High Pressure for 4 minutes, then quick release.
Puree part of the soup with an immersion blender for a thicker base, leaving some broccoli chunks.
Set to Saute, whisk in flour and heavy cream, then stir in the cheddar cheese until melted.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Ladle into bowls and serve warm.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Chicken Marsala
recipes.ingredients:
4 boneless chicken thighs
2 tbsp oil
8 oz mushrooms, sliced
3 cloves garlic, minced
3/4 cup Marsala wine
1 cup chicken broth
2 tbsp flour mixed with 2 tbsp water
2 tbsp butter
Chopped fresh parsley, for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Set Instant Pot to Saute and sear the chicken thighs in oil until browned, then remove.
Saute the mushrooms and garlic for 2-3 minutes.
Add Marsala wine and broth, scraping up any browned bits, then return the chicken to the pot.
Seal the lid and set to Manual/High Pressure for 8 minutes, then quick release.
Remove chicken; set to Saute, whisk in the flour slurry and butter, and simmer until the sauce thickens.
Return chicken to the pot to coat, garnish with parsley, and serve.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Three-Bean Beef Chili
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb ground beef
1 onion, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 can (15 oz) kidney beans, drained
1 can (15 oz) pinto beans, drained
1 can (15 oz) black beans, drained
1 can (28 oz) crushed tomatoes
2 tbsp chili powder
1 tsp smoked paprika
Salt to taste
recipes.instructions:
Set Instant Pot to Saute and brown the ground beef with onion and garlic, draining any excess fat.
Stir in kidney beans, pinto beans, black beans, and crushed tomatoes.
Add chili powder and smoked paprika and stir to combine.
Seal the lid and set to Manual/High Pressure for 12 minutes, then natural release for 10 minutes.
Stir well and season with salt to taste.
Serve with shredded cheese and cornbread.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Cinnamon Applesauce
recipes.ingredients:
8 apples, peeled, cored, and chunked
1/2 cup water
1/4 cup sugar
1 tsp cinnamon
1 tbsp lemon juice
recipes.instructions:
Combine apples, water, sugar, cinnamon, and lemon juice in the Instant Pot.
Seal the lid and set to Manual/High Pressure for 5 minutes.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest.
Mash the apples with a potato masher to your preferred consistency, or blend for a smoother sauce.
Taste and adjust sugar or cinnamon if needed.
Serve warm or chilled.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Mac and Cheese
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups elbow macaroni
2 cups water
1 cup milk
1/2 tsp garlic powder
2 cups shredded cheddar cheese
1/2 cup cream cheese
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Combine macaroni, water, milk, and garlic powder in the Instant Pot, stirring to submerge the pasta.
Seal the lid and set to Manual/High Pressure for 4 minutes, then quick release.
Stir in cheddar cheese and cream cheese until melted and creamy.
If the sauce seems thin, let it sit uncovered for a couple of minutes to thicken as it cools slightly.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately while hot and creamy.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Mushroom Risotto
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups Arborio rice
2 tbsp butter
1 onion, diced
8 oz mushrooms, sliced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1/2 cup dry white wine
3 1/2 cups vegetable broth
1 cup grated Parmesan cheese
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Set Instant Pot to Saute, melt the butter, and cook onion and mushrooms until softened, about 4 minutes.
Add garlic and rice, stirring to toast the rice for 1 minute.
Pour in wine and let it reduce slightly, then add the broth.
Seal the lid and set to Manual/High Pressure for 6 minutes, then quick release.
Stir in Parmesan cheese until creamy, adding more broth if needed for consistency.
Season with salt and pepper and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Spaghetti with Meat Sauce
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb ground beef
1 onion, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 jar (24 oz) marinara sauce
2 cups water
8 oz spaghetti, broken in half
1 tsp dried Italian seasoning
Grated Parmesan, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Set Instant Pot to Saute and brown the ground beef with onion and garlic, draining excess fat.
Stir in marinara sauce, water, and Italian seasoning.
Add the broken spaghetti, pushing it down into the liquid without stirring too much.
Seal the lid and set to Manual/High Pressure for 8 minutes, then quick release.
Stir well to combine the pasta with the sauce.
Serve topped with grated Parmesan.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Beef and Cabbage Soup
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb ground beef
1 onion, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1/2 head cabbage, chopped
2 carrots, sliced
1 can (14.5 oz) diced tomatoes
5 cups beef broth
1 tsp paprika
1 tsp dried oregano
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Set Instant Pot to Saute and brown the ground beef with onion and garlic, draining any excess fat.
Add cabbage, carrots, diced tomatoes, broth, paprika, and oregano.
Seal the lid and set to Manual/High Pressure for 10 minutes, then quick release.
Stir well and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Let sit a few minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Ladle into bowls and serve hot.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Chicken Fried Rice
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb boneless chicken breasts, cubed
1 1/2 cups long-grain rice
1 3/4 cups chicken broth
1 carrot, diced
2 eggs, beaten
3 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp sesame oil
2 scallions, sliced
1 tbsp oil
recipes.instructions:
Set Instant Pot to Saute and cook the chicken in oil until lightly browned.
Stir in rice, broth, and carrot.
Seal the lid and set to Manual/High Pressure for 5 minutes, then natural release for 5 minutes.
Set to Saute, push the rice to one side, scramble the eggs on the other side, then mix together.
Stir in soy sauce and sesame oil.
Garnish with scallions and serve hot.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Hard-Boiled Eggs and Deviled Eggs
recipes.ingredients:
8 eggs
1 cup water
1/3 cup mayonnaise
1 tsp yellow mustard
1 tsp white vinegar
Paprika, for garnish
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Pour water into the Instant Pot and place a trivet or steamer basket inside; arrange the eggs on top.
Seal the lid and set to Manual/High Pressure for 5 minutes.
Quick release the pressure and immediately transfer eggs to an ice bath for 5 minutes.
Peel the eggs, halve them, and scoop the yolks into a bowl.
Mash yolks with mayonnaise, mustard, vinegar, salt, and pepper, then pipe or spoon back into the whites.
Sprinkle with paprika and serve chilled.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Steel-Cut Oatmeal with Blueberries
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup steel-cut oats
3 cups water
1 cup milk
2 tbsp brown sugar
1 tsp vanilla extract
1/4 tsp salt
1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
recipes.instructions:
Combine oats, water, milk, brown sugar, vanilla, and salt in the Instant Pot.
Seal the lid and set to Manual/High Pressure for 4 minutes.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes before opening the lid.
Stir well; the oatmeal will thicken as it sits.
Fold in the blueberries.
Spoon into bowls and top with extra milk or a drizzle of honey.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Egg Bites
recipes.ingredients:
6 eggs
1/2 cup cottage cheese
1/2 cup shredded cheddar cheese
1/4 cup diced cooked bacon or ham
2 tbsp chopped chives
Salt and pepper to taste
1 cup water
recipes.instructions:
Blend eggs and cottage cheese until smooth, then stir in cheddar cheese, bacon, chives, salt, and pepper.
Divide the mixture among silicone egg bite molds or small greased ramekins.
Pour water into the Instant Pot and place a trivet inside; set the molds on top, covering loosely with foil.
Seal the lid and set to Manual/High Pressure for 8 minutes, then natural release for 5 minutes.
Carefully remove the molds and let cool slightly before unmolding.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Cheesecake
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/4 cups graham cracker crumbs
4 tbsp butter, melted
16 oz cream cheese, softened
1/2 cup sugar
2 eggs
1 tsp vanilla extract
1/4 cup sour cream
1 1/2 cups water
recipes.instructions:
Mix graham cracker crumbs with melted butter and press into the bottom of a 7-inch springform pan.
Beat cream cheese and sugar until smooth, then add eggs one at a time, followed by vanilla and sour cream.
Pour the batter over the crust and cover the pan tightly with foil.
Pour water into the Instant Pot, place a trivet inside, and lower the pan onto it using a sling.
Seal the lid and set to Manual/High Pressure for 30 minutes, then natural release for 15 minutes.
Chill the cheesecake at least 4 hours before slicing and serving.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Rice Pudding
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup Arborio rice
3 cups milk
1/3 cup sugar
1/2 tsp cinnamon
1/2 tsp vanilla extract
1/4 tsp salt
1/3 cup raisins
recipes.instructions:
Combine rice, milk, sugar, cinnamon, and salt in the Instant Pot.
Seal the lid and set to Manual/High Pressure for 8 minutes.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes before opening the lid.
Stir in vanilla and raisins; the pudding will thicken further as it cools.
Spoon into bowls and let cool slightly before serving.
Sprinkle with extra cinnamon if desired.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Chicken Enchilada Rice Bowl
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb boneless chicken thighs, cubed
1 1/2 cups long-grain rice
1 can (10 oz) red enchilada sauce
1 1/2 cups chicken broth
1 can (15 oz) black beans, drained
1 cup corn kernels
1 cup shredded Monterey Jack cheese
Chopped cilantro, for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Combine chicken, rice, enchilada sauce, broth, black beans, and corn in the Instant Pot.
Seal the lid and set to Manual/High Pressure for 6 minutes, then natural release for 10 minutes.
Fluff with a fork and stir everything together.
Sprinkle cheese over the top and let it melt from residual heat, covering for a minute if needed.
Garnish with fresh cilantro.
Serve in bowls with extra toppings as desired.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Turkey and Sweet Potato Chili
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb ground turkey
1 onion, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
2 sweet potatoes, cubed
1 can (15 oz) black beans, drained
1 can (28 oz) crushed tomatoes
2 tbsp chili powder
1 tsp smoked paprika
Salt to taste
recipes.instructions:
Set Instant Pot to Saute and brown the ground turkey with onion and garlic.
Add sweet potatoes, black beans, crushed tomatoes, chili powder, and smoked paprika.
Seal the lid and set to Manual/High Pressure for 8 minutes, then natural release for 10 minutes.
Stir well, mashing a few sweet potato pieces to thicken.
Season with salt to taste.
Serve topped with shredded cheese or a dollop of sour cream.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Ham and Corn Chowder
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups diced cooked ham
4 potatoes, cubed
1 onion, diced
2 cups corn kernels
4 cups chicken broth
1 cup heavy cream
2 tbsp flour
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Combine ham, potatoes, onion, corn, and broth in the Instant Pot.
Seal the lid and set to Manual/High Pressure for 8 minutes, then quick release.
Mash some of the potatoes against the side of the pot to thicken the chowder.
Set to Saute, whisk in heavy cream and flour, and simmer 2-3 minutes until thickened.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Ladle into bowls and serve warm.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Fried Chicken
recipes.ingredients:
6 chicken drumsticks and thighs
1 cup buttermilk
1 cup flour
1 tsp paprika
1 tsp garlic powder
1/2 tsp cayenne
Salt and pepper to taste
Cooking spray
recipes.instructions:
Soak the chicken pieces in buttermilk for at least 30 minutes, or overnight in the fridge.
Mix flour with paprika, garlic powder, cayenne, salt, and pepper in a shallow dish.
Dredge each piece of chicken in the seasoned flour, pressing to coat well.
Preheat the air fryer to 380F and spray the basket lightly with cooking spray.
Arrange chicken in a single layer and air fry for 20 minutes, flipping halfway and spraying with more oil, until the chicken reaches 165F and is golden and crisp.
Let rest 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Chicken Tenders
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb chicken tenders
1 cup breadcrumbs
1/2 cup grated Parmesan
1 tsp paprika
1 tsp garlic powder
2 eggs, beaten
1/2 cup flour
Cooking spray
recipes.instructions:
Set up a dredging station: flour in one bowl, beaten eggs in another, and breadcrumbs mixed with Parmesan, paprika, and garlic powder in a third.
Coat each tender in flour, then egg, then the breadcrumb mixture, pressing to adhere.
Preheat the air fryer to 400F and spray the basket with cooking spray.
Arrange tenders in a single layer and spray the tops lightly with oil.
Air fry for 12 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and cooked through to 165F.
Serve with your favorite dipping sauce.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Buffalo Wings
recipes.ingredients:
2 lb chicken wings, split
1 tbsp baking powder
1/2 tsp salt
1/2 cup hot sauce
3 tbsp butter, melted
Celery sticks, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Pat the wings very dry, then toss with baking powder and salt.
Preheat the air fryer to 380F and arrange the wings in a single layer.
Air fry for 20 minutes, flipping halfway through.
Increase the temperature to 400F and air fry 5 more minutes until deeply crisp.
Whisk hot sauce and melted butter together, then toss the hot wings in the sauce.
Serve immediately with celery sticks.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Honey Garlic Wings
recipes.ingredients:
2 lb chicken wings, split
1 tbsp baking powder
1/2 tsp salt
1/3 cup honey
3 tbsp soy sauce
3 cloves garlic, minced
Sesame seeds, for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Pat the wings dry and toss with baking powder and salt.
Preheat the air fryer to 380F and arrange wings in a single layer in the basket.
Air fry for 20 minutes, flipping halfway.
Increase heat to 400F and cook 5 more minutes until crisp and golden.
Meanwhile, simmer honey, soy sauce, and garlic in a small saucepan for 2-3 minutes until slightly thickened.
Toss the hot wings in the sauce and garnish with sesame seeds before serving.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Chicken Parmesan
recipes.ingredients:
3 boneless chicken breasts, pounded thin
1 cup breadcrumbs
1/2 cup grated Parmesan
2 eggs, beaten
1/2 cup flour
1 cup marinara sauce
1 cup shredded mozzarella
Cooking spray
recipes.instructions:
Dredge each chicken breast in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs mixed with Parmesan.
Preheat the air fryer to 375F and spray the basket with cooking spray.
Air fry the chicken for 10 minutes, flipping halfway and spraying the tops with oil.
Top each piece with marinara sauce and mozzarella cheese.
Air fry 3-4 more minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Serve over pasta or with a side salad.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Herb Chicken Breast
recipes.ingredients:
3 boneless chicken breasts
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp dried rosemary
1 tsp dried thyme
1 tsp garlic powder
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Rub the chicken breasts with olive oil, rosemary, thyme, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Preheat the air fryer to 375F.
Arrange the chicken in a single layer in the basket.
Air fry for 16-18 minutes, flipping halfway, until the internal temperature reaches 165F.
Let rest 5 minutes before slicing.
Serve with roasted vegetables or a salad.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Paprika Chicken Thighs
recipes.ingredients:
6 bone-in chicken thighs
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tbsp smoked paprika
1 tsp garlic powder
1 tsp onion powder
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Pat the chicken thighs dry and rub with olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper.
Preheat the air fryer to 380F.
Arrange thighs skin-side down in the basket.
Air fry for 10 minutes, then flip and cook 10 more minutes until the skin is crisp and internal temperature reaches 165F.
Let rest 5 minutes.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Turkey Meatballs
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb ground turkey
1/3 cup breadcrumbs
1 egg
2 cloves garlic, minced
2 tbsp grated Parmesan
1 tsp dried oregano
Salt and pepper to taste
Cooking spray
recipes.instructions:
Mix ground turkey, breadcrumbs, egg, garlic, Parmesan, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Roll the mixture into 1-inch meatballs.
Preheat the air fryer to 375F and spray the basket lightly with cooking spray.
Arrange meatballs in a single layer, leaving space between them.
Air fry for 10-12 minutes, shaking the basket halfway, until cooked through to 165F.
Serve with marinara sauce over pasta or on their own.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Pork Chops
recipes.ingredients:
4 boneless pork chops
1 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp smoked paprika
1 tsp garlic powder
1/2 tsp dried thyme
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Rub the pork chops with olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Preheat the air fryer to 400F.
Arrange chops in a single layer in the basket.
Air fry for 12 minutes, flipping halfway, until the internal temperature reaches 145F.
Let rest 5 minutes before serving.
Serve with roasted vegetables.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Pork Tenderloin
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb pork tenderloin
2 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tbsp honey
1 tsp garlic powder
1 tsp dried rosemary
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Pat the tenderloin dry and rub with Dijon mustard, honey, garlic powder, rosemary, salt, and pepper.
Preheat the air fryer to 375F.
Place the tenderloin in the basket, curling it slightly to fit if needed.
Air fry for 18-20 minutes, flipping halfway, until the internal temperature reaches 145F.
Let rest 5-10 minutes before slicing.
Serve sliced with pan drippings spooned on top.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Bacon-Wrapped Pork Medallions
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb pork tenderloin, cut into 1-inch medallions
8 slices bacon
1 tsp garlic powder
1/2 tsp black pepper
1/4 cup brown sugar
recipes.instructions:
Season the pork medallions with garlic powder and pepper.
Wrap each medallion with a slice of bacon, securing with a toothpick, and press lightly into brown sugar.
Preheat the air fryer to 375F.
Arrange the medallions in a single layer in the basket.
Air fry for 12-14 minutes, flipping halfway, until the bacon is crisp and the pork reaches 145F.
Remove toothpicks and serve warm.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Mini Meatloaves
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb ground beef
1/2 cup breadcrumbs
1 egg
1 small onion, diced
1/4 cup milk
1/3 cup ketchup, divided
1 tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Mix ground beef, breadcrumbs, egg, onion, milk, half the ketchup, salt, and pepper.
Shape the mixture into three individual mini loaves.
Whisk remaining ketchup with brown sugar and Worcestershire sauce, then brush over the loaves.
Preheat the air fryer to 370F and place the loaves in the basket, leaving space between them.
Air fry for 18-20 minutes until the internal temperature reaches 160F.
Let rest 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Burgers
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb ground beef
1 tsp garlic powder
1 tsp onion powder
Salt and pepper to taste
3 slices cheese
3 hamburger buns
Lettuce, tomato, and condiments, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Divide the ground beef into three patties and season with garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper.
Preheat the air fryer to 375F.
Place the patties in the basket in a single layer.
Air fry for 8 minutes, flip, and cook 2 more minutes, adding cheese in the last minute to melt.
Toast the buns in the air fryer for 1-2 minutes if desired.
Assemble burgers with your favorite toppings.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Steak Bites
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb sirloin steak, cubed
1 tbsp olive oil
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tsp smoked paprika
1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
Salt and pepper to taste
2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley
recipes.instructions:
Toss the steak cubes with olive oil, garlic, smoked paprika, Worcestershire sauce, salt, and pepper.
Preheat the air fryer to 400F.
Arrange the steak bites in a single layer in the basket, working in batches if needed.
Air fry for 7-9 minutes, shaking the basket halfway, until browned and cooked to your liking.
Let rest 2-3 minutes.
Garnish with parsley and serve warm.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Garlic Butter Steak
recipes.ingredients:
2 ribeye or sirloin steaks
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp garlic powder
Salt and pepper to taste
3 tbsp butter, softened
1 clove garlic, minced
1 tbsp chopped fresh parsley
recipes.instructions:
Rub the steaks with olive oil, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Preheat the air fryer to 400F.
Air fry the steaks for 10-12 minutes, flipping halfway, to your desired doneness.
Meanwhile, mix softened butter with minced garlic and parsley to make a compound butter.
Let the steaks rest 5 minutes, then top each with a spoonful of garlic butter.
Slice against the grain and serve.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Beef and Vegetable Kabobs
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb sirloin steak, cubed
1 zucchini, sliced
1 red onion, cut into chunks
8 oz mushrooms, halved
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp dried oregano
1 tsp garlic powder
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Toss the steak and vegetables with olive oil, oregano, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Thread the steak and vegetables onto skewers, alternating pieces.
Preheat the air fryer to 400F.
Arrange the skewers in the basket, working in batches if needed.
Air fry for 10-12 minutes, turning halfway, until the beef is cooked to your liking and vegetables are tender.
Serve hot, over rice if desired.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Meatballs in Marinara
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb ground beef
1/2 cup breadcrumbs
1 egg
1/4 cup grated Parmesan
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tsp dried Italian seasoning
2 cups marinara sauce
Cooking spray
recipes.instructions:
Mix ground beef, breadcrumbs, egg, Parmesan, garlic, and Italian seasoning, then roll into 1 1/2-inch meatballs.
Preheat the air fryer to 375F and spray the basket with cooking spray.
Arrange meatballs in a single layer and air fry for 10-12 minutes, shaking halfway, until cooked through.
Warm the marinara sauce in a saucepan on the stovetop.
Add the cooked meatballs to the sauce and simmer 3-4 minutes to combine flavors.
Serve over pasta or as a sub sandwich.

recipes.title: Air Fryer French Fries
recipes.ingredients:
4 russet potatoes, cut into fries
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp paprika
Salt to taste
recipes.instructions:
Soak the cut potatoes in cold water for 20-30 minutes, then drain and pat completely dry.
Toss the fries with olive oil, paprika, and salt.
Preheat the air fryer to 380F.
Air fry the fries for 15 minutes, shaking the basket every 5 minutes.
Increase the temperature to 400F and cook 5 more minutes until golden and crisp.
Serve immediately with ketchup or your favorite dip.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Sweet Potato Fries
recipes.ingredients:
3 sweet potatoes, cut into fries
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp cornstarch
1/2 tsp smoked paprika
1/2 tsp garlic powder
Salt to taste
recipes.instructions:
Toss the sweet potato fries with olive oil and cornstarch until evenly coated.
Sprinkle with smoked paprika, garlic powder, and salt.
Preheat the air fryer to 400F.
Air fry for 15-18 minutes, shaking the basket every 5 minutes, until crisp and tender.
Let cool slightly, as they crisp up more upon standing.
Serve with a dipping sauce of your choice.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Roasted Brussels Sprouts
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb Brussels sprouts, halved
2 tbsp olive oil
2 tbsp balsamic vinegar
1 tbsp honey
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Toss the Brussels sprouts with olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Preheat the air fryer to 380F.
Air fry for 12-14 minutes, shaking the basket halfway, until crisp and browned at the edges.
Whisk balsamic vinegar and honey together in a small bowl.
Drizzle the glaze over the hot Brussels sprouts and toss to coat.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Roasted Broccoli
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb broccoli florets
2 tbsp olive oil
2 cloves garlic, minced
1/4 cup grated Parmesan
Salt and pepper to taste
Lemon wedges, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Toss the broccoli florets with olive oil, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Preheat the air fryer to 400F.
Air fry for 7-9 minutes, shaking the basket halfway, until crisp-tender and lightly charred.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese immediately after cooking so it melts slightly.
Squeeze fresh lemon juice over the top.
Serve warm as a side dish.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Zucchini Chips
recipes.ingredients:
2 zucchini, thinly sliced
1/2 cup breadcrumbs
1/4 cup grated Parmesan
1 egg, beaten
1/2 tsp garlic powder
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Mix breadcrumbs with Parmesan, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Dip zucchini slices in beaten egg, then coat in the breadcrumb mixture.
Preheat the air fryer to 380F.
Arrange the zucchini slices in a single layer, working in batches as needed.
Air fry for 12-15 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and crisp.
Serve warm with marinara sauce for dipping.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Corn on the Cob
recipes.ingredients:
3 ears corn, husked
2 tbsp butter, melted
1/2 tsp garlic powder
Salt and pepper to taste
Chopped fresh parsley, for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Brush the corn with melted butter and sprinkle with garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Preheat the air fryer to 380F.
Arrange the corn in the basket, cutting the ears in half if needed to fit.
Air fry for 10-12 minutes, turning halfway, until tender and lightly charred in spots.
Brush with any remaining butter.
Garnish with parsley and serve hot.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Roasted Carrots
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb carrots, cut into sticks
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tbsp honey
1/2 tsp dried thyme
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Toss the carrot sticks with olive oil, honey, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Preheat the air fryer to 380F.
Arrange the carrots in a single layer in the basket.
Air fry for 12-14 minutes, shaking halfway, until tender and caramelized at the edges.
Taste and adjust seasoning if needed.
Serve warm as a side dish.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Baked Potatoes
recipes.ingredients:
3 russet potatoes
1 tbsp olive oil
Salt to taste
Butter, sour cream, shredded cheese, and chives, for topping
recipes.instructions:
Scrub the potatoes and pierce each several times with a fork.
Rub the potatoes with olive oil and sprinkle with salt.
Preheat the air fryer to 400F.
Air fry the potatoes for 35-40 minutes, turning halfway, until a fork easily pierces the center.
Slice open and fluff the inside with a fork.
Top with butter, sour cream, cheese, and chives as desired.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Loaded Potato Wedges
recipes.ingredients:
4 russet potatoes, cut into wedges
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp smoked paprika
1 tsp garlic powder
Salt and pepper to taste
1 cup shredded cheddar cheese
4 slices bacon, cooked and crumbled
Sliced scallions, for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Toss the potato wedges with olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Preheat the air fryer to 400F.
Air fry the wedges for 18-20 minutes, shaking halfway, until crisp and golden.
Sprinkle shredded cheese and bacon over the wedges and air fry 2 more minutes until the cheese melts.
Garnish with scallions.
Serve with sour cream on the side.
