recipes.title: Air Fryer Mozzarella Sticks
recipes.ingredients:
12 mozzarella string cheese sticks, halved and frozen
1/2 cup flour
2 eggs, beaten
1 cup breadcrumbs
1 tsp dried Italian seasoning
Cooking spray
Marinara sauce, for dipping
recipes.instructions:
Dredge each frozen mozzarella piece in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs mixed with Italian seasoning, pressing to coat well.
Freeze the coated sticks for at least 30 minutes to help them hold their shape.
Preheat the air fryer to 390F and spray the basket with cooking spray.
Arrange the sticks in a single layer, leaving space between them.
Air fry for 6-8 minutes, watching closely, until golden and just beginning to ooze.
Serve immediately with warm marinara sauce.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Onion Rings
recipes.ingredients:
2 large onions, cut into rings
1 cup flour
1 tsp paprika
1 cup buttermilk
1 1/2 cups breadcrumbs
Cooking spray
recipes.instructions:
Separate the onion slices into rings and soak in buttermilk for 10 minutes.
Mix flour with paprika in one bowl and breadcrumbs in another.
Dredge each ring in flour, then buttermilk again, then breadcrumbs.
Preheat the air fryer to 390F and spray the basket with cooking spray.
Arrange rings in a single layer, spray tops with oil, and air fry for 10-12 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and crisp.
Serve hot with dipping sauce.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Vegetable Egg Rolls
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups shredded cabbage
1 carrot, shredded
3 scallions, sliced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 tsp sesame oil
10 egg roll wrappers
Cooking spray
recipes.instructions:
Saute cabbage, carrot, scallions, and garlic in a skillet with soy sauce and sesame oil for 4-5 minutes until softened; let cool slightly.
Place a spoonful of filling on each egg roll wrapper and roll up tightly, sealing the edges with water.
Preheat the air fryer to 390F and spray the basket with cooking spray.
Arrange the egg rolls seam-side down in a single layer and spray the tops with oil.
Air fry for 8-10 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and crisp.
Serve with sweet chili or soy dipping sauce.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Spring Rolls
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup shredded cabbage
1 carrot, julienned
1/2 cup bean sprouts
2 scallions, sliced
1 tbsp soy sauce
8 spring roll wrappers
Cooking spray
recipes.instructions:
Saute cabbage, carrot, bean sprouts, and scallions with soy sauce for 3-4 minutes until just softened; let cool.
Spoon filling onto each wrapper and roll tightly, tucking in the sides and sealing with water.
Preheat the air fryer to 380F and spray the basket lightly with cooking spray.
Arrange spring rolls in a single layer and spray the tops with oil.
Air fry for 7-8 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and crisp.
Serve with a sweet and sour dipping sauce.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Chicken Quesadillas
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups shredded cooked chicken
1 1/2 cups shredded Monterey Jack cheese
1/2 onion, finely diced
6 flour tortillas
1 tsp smoked paprika
1/2 tsp dried oregano
1/2 tsp garlic powder
Cooking spray
Salsa and sour cream, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Toss the shredded chicken with smoked paprika, oregano, garlic powder, and onion.
Sprinkle cheese and chicken mixture over half of each tortilla, then fold over to close.
Preheat the air fryer to 370F and spray the basket with cooking spray.
Place quesadillas in the basket, spraying the tops lightly with oil.
Air fry for 6-8 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and the cheese is melted.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa and sour cream.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Grilled Cheese
recipes.ingredients:
6 slices bread
4 tbsp butter, softened
6 slices cheddar cheese
recipes.instructions:
Butter one side of each slice of bread.
Assemble sandwiches with cheese between the unbuttered sides, butter facing out.
Preheat the air fryer to 370F.
Place sandwiches in the basket and air fry for 4 minutes.
Flip carefully and air fry 3-4 more minutes until golden and the cheese is melted.
Slice and serve warm.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Personal Pizzas
recipes.ingredients:
3 personal-size pizza crusts or naan bread
3/4 cup pizza sauce
2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese
1/2 cup sliced mushrooms
1 tsp dried oregano
Cooking spray
recipes.instructions:
Spread pizza sauce evenly over each crust.
Top with mozzarella cheese and mushrooms, then sprinkle with oregano.
Preheat the air fryer to 375F and spray the basket lightly with cooking spray.
Place one pizza at a time in the basket.
Air fry for 6-8 minutes until the cheese is melted and the crust is crisp.
Slice and serve hot.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Falafel
recipes.ingredients:
2 cans (15 oz each) chickpeas, drained and patted dry
1 small onion, chopped
3 cloves garlic
1/2 cup chopped fresh parsley
2 tbsp chopped fresh cilantro
1 tsp ground coriander
1/2 tsp baking powder
3 tbsp flour
Salt and pepper to taste
Cooking spray
recipes.instructions:
Pulse chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley, cilantro, and coriander in a food processor until finely chopped but not pureed.
Stir in baking powder, flour, salt, and pepper, then chill the mixture for 15 minutes.
Shape into small patties or balls.
Preheat the air fryer to 375F and spray the basket with cooking spray.
Arrange the falafel in a single layer, spray tops with oil, and air fry for 12-15 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and crisp.
Serve in pita with tahini sauce and vegetables.
recipes.notes: Seasoned with coriander for a bright, herby flavor.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Stuffed Portobello Mushrooms
recipes.ingredients:
4 large portobello mushroom caps, stemmed
1 cup breadcrumbs
1/2 cup grated Parmesan
2 cloves garlic, minced
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp dried Italian seasoning
1/2 cup shredded mozzarella
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Brush the mushroom caps with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Mix breadcrumbs, Parmesan, garlic, and Italian seasoning, then fill each mushroom cap with the mixture.
Preheat the air fryer to 370F.
Place stuffed mushrooms in the basket in a single layer.
Air fry for 8-10 minutes, then top with mozzarella and cook 2-3 more minutes until melted and golden.
Serve warm as a main or side.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Breakfast Sausage Patties
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb ground pork
1 tsp dried sage
1/2 tsp garlic powder
1/2 tsp fennel seed
1/4 tsp red pepper flakes
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Mix the ground pork with sage, garlic powder, fennel seed, red pepper flakes, salt, and pepper.
Shape into small patties, about 1/2 inch thick.
Preheat the air fryer to 375F.
Arrange the patties in a single layer in the basket.
Air fry for 8-10 minutes, flipping halfway, until browned and cooked through to 160F.
Serve hot with eggs and toast.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Bacon
recipes.ingredients: 8 slices bacon
recipes.instructions:
Preheat the air fryer to 375F.
Arrange the bacon slices in a single layer in the basket, working in batches if needed.
Air fry for 7-9 minutes, checking at 6 minutes, until crisp to your liking.
Remove and drain on paper towels.
Discard excess grease from the basket before the next batch.
Serve warm alongside eggs and toast.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Vegetable Frittata
recipes.ingredients:
6 eggs
1/4 cup milk
1/2 onion, diced
1/2 zucchini, diced
1/2 cup chopped spinach
1/2 cup shredded cheddar cheese
Salt and pepper to taste
Cooking spray
recipes.instructions:
Whisk eggs and milk together, then stir in onion, zucchini, spinach, cheese, salt, and pepper.
Spray a small oven-safe pan that fits in the air fryer basket with cooking spray and pour in the egg mixture.
Preheat the air fryer to 320F.
Place the pan in the basket and air fry for 13-15 minutes until the eggs are set in the center.
Let cool slightly before slicing.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Hash Browns
recipes.ingredients:
3 russet potatoes, peeled and shredded
2 tbsp cornstarch
2 tbsp oil
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Squeeze as much excess moisture from the shredded potatoes as possible using a clean towel.
Toss the potatoes with cornstarch, oil, salt, and pepper.
Preheat the air fryer to 380F and shape the potatoes into small patties.
Arrange the patties in a single layer in the basket.
Air fry for 12-15 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and crisp.
Serve hot with breakfast eggs and bacon.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Cinnamon Sugar Donuts
recipes.ingredients:
1 can refrigerated biscuit dough
4 tbsp butter, melted
1/2 cup sugar
1 tbsp cinnamon
Cooking spray
recipes.instructions:
Separate the biscuits and cut a hole in the center of each with a small cutter to form donut shapes.
Preheat the air fryer to 350F and spray the basket with cooking spray.
Arrange the donuts and donut holes in a single layer, spacing them apart.
Air fry for 5-6 minutes until puffed and golden.
Brush the warm donuts with melted butter, then toss in a mixture of sugar and cinnamon.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Apple Chips
recipes.ingredients:
3 apples, cored and very thinly sliced
1 tbsp lemon juice
1 tsp cinnamon
1 tbsp sugar (optional)
recipes.instructions:
Toss the apple slices with lemon juice to prevent browning.
Sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar if using.
Preheat the air fryer to 320F.
Arrange the apple slices in a single layer, working in batches, and air fry for 12-15 minutes, flipping halfway, until dry and lightly golden.
Let cool completely on a rack; they crisp up further as they cool.
Store in an airtight container.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Churros
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup water
4 tbsp butter
1 tbsp sugar
1/4 tsp salt
1 cup flour
2 eggs
1/2 cup sugar mixed with 1 tbsp cinnamon, for coating
Cooking spray
recipes.instructions:
Bring water, butter, sugar, and salt to a boil, then stir in flour until a dough forms and pulls away from the pan.
Let cool 5 minutes, then beat in the eggs one at a time until smooth and glossy.
Pipe the dough into 4-inch strips using a piping bag fitted with a star tip.
Preheat the air fryer to 375F and spray the basket with cooking spray; arrange the churros in a single layer.
Air fry for 8-10 minutes until golden and puffed, spraying tops lightly with oil halfway through.
Toss the warm churros in cinnamon sugar and serve.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipes.ingredients:
1/2 cup butter, softened
1/2 cup brown sugar
1/4 cup sugar
1 egg
1 tsp vanilla extract
1 1/4 cups flour
1/2 tsp baking soda
1/4 tsp salt
3/4 cup chocolate chips
recipes.instructions:
Cream butter with brown sugar and sugar until fluffy, then beat in egg and vanilla.
Stir in flour, baking soda, and salt until just combined, then fold in chocolate chips.
Preheat the air fryer to 320F and line the basket with parchment paper.
Scoop rounded tablespoons of dough onto the parchment, spacing them apart.
Air fry for 7-9 minutes until the edges are golden but the centers still look slightly soft.
Let cool on the parchment for a few minutes before removing.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Baked Apples
recipes.ingredients:
3 apples, cored
1/4 cup rolled oats
1/4 cup brown sugar
1 tsp cinnamon
2 tbsp butter, softened
1/4 cup chopped walnuts (optional)
recipes.instructions:
Mix oats, brown sugar, cinnamon, softened butter, and walnuts if using into a crumbly filling.
Stuff the mixture into the cored center of each apple.
Preheat the air fryer to 350F.
Place the apples in the basket, standing upright.
Air fry for 13-15 minutes until the apples are tender and the filling is golden.
Serve warm with a scoop of vanilla ice cream.

recipes.title: Air Fryer S'mores Dip
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups chocolate chips
2 cups mini marshmallows
Graham crackers, for dipping
recipes.instructions:
Spread the chocolate chips evenly in a small oven-safe skillet or dish that fits in the air fryer.
Top evenly with mini marshmallows.
Preheat the air fryer to 350F.
Place the dish in the basket and air fry for 5-6 minutes, watching closely, until the marshmallows are toasted and golden.
Remove carefully, as the dish will be hot.
Serve immediately with graham crackers for dipping.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Honey Ginger Chicken Skewers
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb boneless chicken breast, cubed
1/4 cup soy sauce
2 tbsp honey
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tsp grated fresh ginger
1 tbsp sesame oil
Sesame seeds, for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Whisk soy sauce, honey, garlic, ginger, and sesame oil together, then marinate the chicken cubes for at least 20 minutes.
Thread the chicken onto skewers.
Preheat the air fryer to 380F.
Arrange the skewers in the basket in a single layer, working in batches if needed.
Air fry for 9-10 minutes, turning halfway, until cooked through and lightly charred.
Garnish with sesame seeds and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Cajun Chicken Bites
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb boneless chicken breast, cubed
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tbsp smoked paprika
1 tsp garlic powder
1 tsp onion powder
1/2 tsp cayenne
1/2 tsp dried oregano
Salt to taste
recipes.instructions:
Toss the chicken cubes with olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, cayenne, oregano, and salt.
Preheat the air fryer to 400F.
Arrange the chicken in a single layer in the basket, working in batches if needed.
Air fry for 8-10 minutes, shaking the basket halfway, until browned and cooked through to 165F.
Let rest 2 minutes.
Serve over rice or in a wrap.

recipes.title: Rice Cooker Coconut Rice
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups jasmine rice, rinsed
1 can (14 oz) coconut milk
1/2 cup water
1 tbsp sugar
1/4 tsp salt
recipes.instructions:
Combine rinsed rice, coconut milk, water, sugar, and salt in the rice cooker bowl.
Stir briefly to dissolve the sugar and salt.
Close the lid and set the rice cooker to the White Rice or standard cook setting.
Let the cooker run through its full cycle and switch to Keep Warm automatically.
Let the rice rest for 5-10 minutes before opening the lid.
Fluff with a fork and serve as a side to curries or grilled dishes.

recipes.title: Rice Cooker Cilantro Lime Rice
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups long-grain white rice, rinsed
1 3/4 cups water
1 tbsp olive oil
1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro
2 tbsp lime juice
1/2 tsp salt
recipes.instructions:
Combine rinsed rice, water, olive oil, and salt in the rice cooker bowl.
Close the lid and start the standard White Rice cycle.
Once the cooker switches to Keep Warm, let the rice sit covered for 5 minutes.
Fluff the rice with a fork.
Stir in the cilantro and lime juice.
Serve alongside Mexican or Tex-Mex dishes.

recipes.title: Rice Cooker Chicken and Rice Pilaf
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb boneless chicken thighs, cubed
1 1/2 cups long-grain rice, rinsed
1 onion, diced
1 carrot, diced
2 1/4 cups chicken broth
1 tbsp butter
1/2 tsp dried thyme
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Season the chicken with salt, pepper, and thyme.
Combine chicken, rice, onion, carrot, broth, and butter in the rice cooker bowl.
Close the lid and set to the standard White Rice or Cook cycle.
Let the cooker run through its full cycle until it switches to Keep Warm.
Let sit covered for 5-10 minutes, then fluff everything together with a fork.
Serve hot as a complete one-pot meal.

recipes.title: Rice Cooker Spanish Rice
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups long-grain rice, rinsed
1 tbsp olive oil
1 onion, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 can (8 oz) tomato sauce
1 3/4 cups chicken broth
1 tsp smoked paprika
1/2 tsp dried oregano
Salt to taste
recipes.instructions:
Saute the onion and garlic in olive oil in a small skillet until softened, about 3 minutes, then transfer to the rice cooker bowl.
Add rinsed rice, tomato sauce, broth, smoked paprika, and oregano to the bowl and stir to combine.
Close the lid and start the standard White Rice cycle.
Let the cooker finish and switch to Keep Warm.
Let sit covered for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Season with salt to taste and serve.

recipes.title: Rice Cooker Mexican Rice with Black Beans
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups long-grain rice, rinsed
1 can (15 oz) black beans, drained
1 can (14.5 oz) diced tomatoes
1 onion, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 3/4 cups vegetable broth
1 tsp chili powder
1/2 tsp smoked paprika
Chopped cilantro, for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Combine rice, black beans, diced tomatoes, onion, garlic, broth, chili powder, and smoked paprika in the rice cooker bowl.
Stir well to distribute the ingredients evenly.
Close the lid and start the standard White Rice cycle.
Let the cooker finish and switch to Keep Warm, then let sit covered for 5 minutes.
Fluff with a fork.
Garnish with cilantro and serve warm.

recipes.title: Rice Cooker Chicken Congee
recipes.ingredients:
3/4 cup jasmine rice, rinsed
8 cups chicken broth
1 lb boneless chicken thighs
1 tbsp grated fresh ginger
Sliced scallions, for garnish
Soy sauce, for serving
Salt to taste
recipes.instructions:
Combine rinsed rice, chicken broth, chicken thighs, and ginger in the rice cooker bowl.
Close the lid and select the Porridge or Congee setting if available; otherwise use the standard cook cycle and check periodically.
Let the congee simmer, stirring occasionally if your cooker allows, until the rice breaks down into a thick, creamy porridge, about 90 minutes.
Remove the chicken, shred it, and stir it back into the congee.
Season with salt to taste.
Ladle into bowls and top with scallions and a drizzle of soy sauce.

recipes.title: Rice Cooker Vegetable Rice Bowl
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups long-grain rice, rinsed
1 3/4 cups vegetable broth
1 carrot, diced
1/2 cup frozen corn
2 tbsp soy sauce
1 tsp sesame oil
2 eggs, beaten
2 scallions, sliced
recipes.instructions:
Combine rinsed rice, broth, carrot, and corn in the rice cooker bowl.
Close the lid and start the standard White Rice cycle.
When the cycle finishes, scramble the beaten eggs separately in a small skillet until just set.
Fluff the rice, then stir in soy sauce, sesame oil, and the scrambled eggs.
Toss everything together gently.
Garnish with scallions and serve warm.

recipes.title: Rice Cooker Teriyaki Chicken and Rice
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb boneless chicken thighs, cubed
1 1/2 cups long-grain rice, rinsed
1 3/4 cups chicken broth
1/3 cup soy sauce
3 tbsp brown sugar
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tsp grated fresh ginger
1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 1 tbsp water
recipes.instructions:
Combine chicken, rice, and broth in the rice cooker bowl.
Close the lid and start the standard White Rice or Cook cycle.
While the rice cooks, simmer soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, and ginger in a small saucepan, then whisk in the cornstarch slurry until thickened into a glaze.
Once the rice cooker finishes and switches to Keep Warm, fluff the chicken and rice together.
Pour the teriyaki glaze over the top and stir gently to coat.
Serve hot, garnished with sesame seeds if desired.

recipes.title: Rice Cooker Sausage and Rice Jambalaya
recipes.ingredients:
8 oz andouille sausage, sliced
1 lb boneless chicken thighs, cubed
1 1/2 cups long-grain rice, rinsed
1 onion, diced
2 celery stalks, diced
1 can (14.5 oz) diced tomatoes
2 cups chicken broth
1 tsp smoked paprika
1/2 tsp cayenne
1 tsp dried thyme
recipes.instructions:
Combine sausage, chicken, rice, onion, celery, diced tomatoes, and broth in the rice cooker bowl.
Stir in smoked paprika, cayenne, and thyme.
Close the lid and start the standard White Rice or Cook cycle.
Let the cooker run through its full cycle until it switches to Keep Warm.
Let sit covered for 5-10 minutes, then fluff everything together with a fork.
Serve hot, garnished with sliced scallions.

recipes.title: Rice Cooker Mushroom Parmesan Risotto
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups Arborio rice
2 tbsp butter
1 onion, diced
8 oz mushrooms, sliced
2 cloves garlic, minced
3 1/2 cups vegetable broth
1 cup grated Parmesan cheese
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Saute onion and mushrooms in butter in a skillet until softened, about 5 minutes, then stir in garlic and cook 1 more minute.
Transfer the mixture to the rice cooker bowl along with the Arborio rice and broth.
Close the lid and select the Risotto setting if available, or use the standard White Rice cycle, stirring once or twice if possible.
Once the cycle finishes, stir in the Parmesan cheese until creamy.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, adding a splash of warm broth if the risotto seems too thick.
Serve immediately while hot and creamy.

recipes.title: Rice Cooker Sushi Rice
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups sushi rice, rinsed until water runs clear
1 3/4 cups water
3 tbsp rice vinegar
2 tbsp sugar
1/2 tsp salt
recipes.instructions:
Combine rinsed sushi rice and water in the rice cooker bowl.
Close the lid and start the Sushi Rice or standard White Rice cycle.
While the rice cooks, whisk rice vinegar, sugar, and salt together until dissolved.
Once the rice finishes cooking, transfer it to a wide bowl and drizzle with the vinegar mixture.
Fold gently with a spatula, fanning as you go, until the rice is glossy and has cooled slightly.
Use for hand rolls, sushi bowls, or rice balls.

recipes.title: Rice Cooker Rice Pudding
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup short-grain rice, rinsed
3 cups milk
1/3 cup sugar
1/2 tsp vanilla extract
1/2 tsp cinnamon
1/4 cup raisins
recipes.instructions:
Combine rinsed rice, milk, sugar, and cinnamon in the rice cooker bowl.
Close the lid and start the standard White Rice cycle, checking occasionally and stirring if your cooker allows the lid to be opened partway.
Once the rice is tender and the mixture has thickened, stir in the vanilla and raisins.
If the pudding is too thin, run the Keep Warm cycle for another 10-15 minutes uncovered, stirring occasionally.
Let cool slightly before serving, as it thickens further as it cools.
Sprinkle with extra cinnamon before serving.

recipes.title: Rice Cooker Ginger Jasmine Rice
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups jasmine rice, rinsed
1 3/4 cups water
1 tbsp grated fresh ginger
1 tsp sesame oil
1/2 tsp salt
recipes.instructions:
Combine rinsed rice, water, ginger, sesame oil, and salt in the rice cooker bowl.
Stir briefly to distribute the ginger.
Close the lid and start the standard White Rice cycle.
Let the cooker run through its cycle and switch to Keep Warm.
Let the rice rest covered for 5 minutes before fluffing with a fork.
Serve as a fragrant side to stir-fries or roasted meats.

recipes.title: Rice Cooker Steamed Mixed Vegetables
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups broccoli florets
2 carrots, sliced
1 zucchini, sliced
1 cup water
2 tbsp olive oil
1 clove garlic, minced
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Pour water into the rice cooker bowl and fit the steamer basket or tray on top.
Arrange the broccoli, carrots, and zucchini in the steamer basket.
Close the lid and select the Steam function, or the standard cook cycle if no dedicated steam setting exists.
Steam for 12-15 minutes until the vegetables are crisp-tender, checking partway through.
Toss the hot vegetables with olive oil, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Serve immediately as a side dish.

recipes.title: Rice Cooker Steamed Vegetable Dumplings
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup finely shredded cabbage
1/2 cup shredded carrot
2 scallions, minced
1 clove garlic, minced
1 tsp soy sauce
1 tsp sesame oil
20 round dumpling wrappers
1 cup water
Soy sauce and chili oil, for dipping
recipes.instructions:
Mix cabbage, carrot, scallions, garlic, soy sauce, and sesame oil to make the filling.
Place a spoonful of filling in the center of each wrapper, wet the edges, and fold into a pleated dumpling shape.
Pour water into the rice cooker bowl and fit a lightly oiled steamer basket on top.
Arrange the dumplings in the basket in a single layer, not touching.
Close the lid and select the Steam setting, steaming for 10-12 minutes until the wrappers turn translucent.
Serve hot with soy sauce and chili oil for dipping.

recipes.title: Rice Cooker Hainanese-Style Chicken and Rice
recipes.ingredients:
1 whole chicken, quartered, or 4 bone-in chicken thighs
2 cups jasmine rice, rinsed
2 1/4 cups chicken broth
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp grated fresh ginger
1 tsp sesame oil
2 scallions, sliced
Soy sauce and chili sauce, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Place the chicken pieces in the rice cooker bowl with enough broth to mostly cover them.
Close the lid and start the standard cook cycle, cooking until the chicken reaches 165F, about 25-30 minutes.
Remove the chicken and set aside; skim and reserve the flavorful broth.
Add the rinsed rice, reserved broth (topped up to 2 1/4 cups total), garlic, ginger, and sesame oil to the bowl.
Close the lid and run the White Rice cycle until finished.
Slice the chicken and serve over the rice, garnished with scallions and soy sauce.

recipes.title: Rice Cooker Quinoa and Vegetable Pilaf
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups quinoa, rinsed
2 1/4 cups vegetable broth
1 carrot, diced
1/2 cup frozen corn
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp dried thyme
2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Combine rinsed quinoa, broth, carrot, corn, olive oil, and thyme in the rice cooker bowl.
Close the lid and start the standard White Rice or Quinoa cycle.
Let the cooker run through its cycle until it switches to Keep Warm.
Let sit covered for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Stir in parsley and season with salt and pepper.
Serve warm or at room temperature.

recipes.title: Rice Cooker Steel-Cut Oatmeal
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup steel-cut oats
3 cups milk
1 cup water
2 tbsp brown sugar
1/2 tsp cinnamon
1/4 tsp salt
Fresh fruit, for topping
recipes.instructions:
Combine oats, milk, water, brown sugar, cinnamon, and salt in the rice cooker bowl.
Close the lid and start the standard White Rice or Porridge cycle.
Let the oats cook, checking near the end since cook times vary by machine, until thick and creamy.
If the oats finish before fully thickened, run an additional short cook cycle.
Stir well before serving.
Top with fresh fruit, nuts, or a drizzle of honey.

recipes.title: Rice Cooker Coconut Sticky Rice with Mango
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups glutinous sticky rice, soaked 4 hours and drained
1 cup coconut milk
1/4 cup sugar
1/4 tsp salt
2 ripe mangoes, sliced
1 tbsp toasted sesame seeds
recipes.instructions:
Place the soaked and drained sticky rice in the rice cooker bowl with just enough water to reach the top of the rice.
Close the lid and start the standard White Rice cycle, or use a Steam setting with the rice in a steamer basket for more authentic texture.
While the rice cooks, warm the coconut milk with sugar and salt in a small saucepan until dissolved; reserve a few tablespoons for drizzling.
Once the rice is tender, stir in most of the sweetened coconut milk and let it absorb for 10 minutes.
Scoop the sticky rice onto plates alongside sliced mango.
Drizzle with the reserved coconut milk and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Rice Cooker Ham and Cheese Rice Casserole
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups long-grain rice, rinsed
2 cups diced cooked ham
2 1/4 cups chicken broth
1 cup shredded cheddar cheese
1/2 onion, diced
1/2 tsp garlic powder
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Combine rice, ham, broth, onion, and garlic powder in the rice cooker bowl.
Close the lid and start the standard White Rice cycle.
Let the cooker run through its full cycle until it switches to Keep Warm.
Fluff the rice and stir in the shredded cheese until melted.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot as a simple one-pot dinner.

recipes.title: Rice Cooker Beef and Broccoli Rice Bowl
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb flank steak, thinly sliced
1 1/2 cups long-grain rice, rinsed
1 3/4 cups beef broth
1/3 cup soy sauce
2 tbsp brown sugar
2 cloves garlic, minced
2 cups broccoli florets
1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 1 tbsp water
recipes.instructions:
Combine steak, rice, and broth in the rice cooker bowl.
Close the lid and start the standard White Rice or Cook cycle.
About 8 minutes before the cycle ends, if your cooker allows opening mid-cycle, place broccoli florets on top to steam; otherwise steam the broccoli separately for 4-5 minutes.
Once the rice and steak are done, simmer soy sauce, brown sugar, and garlic in a small saucepan, thickening with the cornstarch slurry.
Combine the rice, steak, broccoli, and sauce together in the rice cooker bowl, stirring to coat.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Rice Cooker Herbed Wild Rice Pilaf
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups wild rice blend, rinsed
2 3/4 cups vegetable broth
1 onion, diced
1 carrot, diced
2 tbsp butter
1 tsp dried thyme
1 tsp dried rosemary
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Combine wild rice blend, broth, onion, carrot, butter, thyme, and rosemary in the rice cooker bowl.
Close the lid and start the standard White Rice cycle, or a Brown Rice/Mixed Grain setting if available since wild rice takes longer.
Let the cooker run through its full cycle, checking that the rice is tender since cook times vary.
Let sit covered for 5-10 minutes after the cycle ends.
Fluff with a fork and season with salt and pepper.
Serve warm as a hearty side dish.

recipes.title: Rice Cooker Steamed Artichokes
recipes.ingredients:
3 whole artichokes, trimmed
1 lemon, halved
2 cups water
2 cloves garlic
1 bay leaf
Melted butter or aioli, for dipping
recipes.instructions:
Rub the cut edges of the trimmed artichokes with lemon to prevent browning.
Pour water into the rice cooker bowl along with garlic and bay leaf, then fit the steamer basket on top.
Arrange the artichokes stem-side down in the steamer basket.
Close the lid and select the Steam function, steaming for 30-35 minutes until a leaf pulls away easily.
Check water levels partway through and add more if needed.
Serve warm with melted butter or aioli for dipping the leaves.

recipes.title: Rice Cooker Steamed Corn on the Cob
recipes.ingredients:
3 ears corn, husked and halved
1 1/2 cups water
2 tbsp butter
Salt to taste
recipes.instructions:
Pour water into the rice cooker bowl and fit the steamer basket on top.
Arrange the corn pieces in the steamer basket.
Close the lid and select the Steam function.
Steam for 10-12 minutes until the kernels are tender.
Remove and brush with melted butter.
Sprinkle with salt and serve warm.

recipes.title: Rice Cooker Steamed Pork Buns
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups diced cooked pork shoulder or roast pork
2 tbsp hoisin sauce
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 tsp sesame oil
1 tsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water
12 store-bought or homemade bao dough rounds
2 cups water
recipes.instructions:
Simmer pork with hoisin sauce, soy sauce, and sesame oil in a skillet, then stir in the cornstarch slurry to thicken into a sticky filling; let cool.
Spoon filling onto the center of each bao dough round and pleat closed, pinching to seal at the top.
Pour water into the rice cooker bowl and line the steamer basket with parchment or cabbage leaves; arrange the buns with space between them.
Close the lid and select the Steam function, steaming for 15-18 minutes until the buns are puffed and cooked through.
Let rest 2 minutes before removing from the basket.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Rice Cooker Lemon Herb Rice
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups long-grain rice, rinsed
1 3/4 cups vegetable broth
Zest and juice of 1 lemon
2 tbsp butter
2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Combine rinsed rice, broth, lemon zest, and butter in the rice cooker bowl.
Close the lid and start the standard White Rice cycle.
Let the cooker finish and switch to Keep Warm.
Fluff the rice with a fork and stir in the lemon juice and parsley.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve as a bright side to roasted chicken or grilled vegetables.

recipes.title: Rice Cooker Turkey and Rice Casserole
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups diced cooked turkey
1 1/2 cups long-grain rice, rinsed
2 1/4 cups chicken broth
1 onion, diced
1 carrot, diced
1 cup shredded cheddar cheese
1/2 tsp dried sage
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Combine turkey, rice, broth, onion, carrot, and sage in the rice cooker bowl.
Close the lid and start the standard White Rice cycle.
Let the cooker run through its full cycle until it switches to Keep Warm.
Fluff everything together and stir in the shredded cheese until melted.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, a great way to use up leftover turkey.

recipes.title: Rice Cooker Steamed Chinese Egg Custard
recipes.ingredients:
4 eggs
1 1/2 cups warm milk
3 tbsp sugar
1/2 tsp vanilla extract
1 1/2 cups water
recipes.instructions:
Whisk eggs, warm milk, sugar, and vanilla together gently, avoiding too many bubbles, then strain through a fine sieve.
Pour the mixture into a heatproof dish that fits inside the rice cooker.
Pour water into the rice cooker bowl and fit the steamer basket or trivet on top; place the dish on the basket and cover loosely with foil.
Close the lid and select the Steam function, steaming for 15-18 minutes until just set with a slight jiggle in the center.
Let cool slightly before serving, as the custard continues to set.
Serve warm or chilled.

recipes.title: Bread Maker Classic White Bread
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup warm milk
2 tbsp warm water
2 tbsp butter, softened
3 tbsp sugar
1 tsp salt
3 cups bread flour
2 1/4 tsp active dry yeast
recipes.instructions:
Add milk, water, and butter to the bread maker pan first, followed by sugar and salt.
Add the bread flour on top, covering the liquids completely.
Make a small well in the center of the flour and add the yeast, making sure it doesn't touch the liquid.
Select the Basic or White Bread cycle with a Light or Medium crust setting and start the machine.
Let the machine complete its full mix, rise, and bake cycle without opening the lid.
Once done, remove the pan, turn out the loaf onto a rack, and let cool completely before slicing.

recipes.title: Bread Maker Honey Wheat Bread
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup warm water
2 tbsp honey
2 tbsp vegetable oil
1 1/2 cups bread flour
1 1/2 cups whole wheat flour
1 1/4 tsp salt
2 tsp active dry yeast
recipes.instructions:
Add warm water, honey, and oil to the bread maker pan.
Add bread flour and whole wheat flour on top, then salt in one corner.
Make a well in the flour and add the yeast, keeping it away from the salt and liquid.
Select the Whole Wheat cycle with a Medium crust setting and start the machine.
Allow the full cycle to complete, including the longer rise time typical for whole wheat cycles.
Remove the loaf, cool completely on a rack before slicing.

recipes.title: Bread Maker French Bread
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/3 cups warm water
1 tbsp sugar
1 1/2 tsp salt
1 tbsp olive oil
3 3/4 cups bread flour
2 tsp active dry yeast
recipes.instructions:
Add warm water, sugar, salt, and olive oil to the bread maker pan.
Add the bread flour on top, covering the liquid.
Make a well in the flour and add the yeast.
Select the French Bread cycle, which uses a longer rise for a crustier loaf, and start the machine.
Let the machine complete its full cycle without interruption.
Remove the loaf and cool on a wire rack for at least 20 minutes before slicing.

recipes.title: Bread Maker Rye Bread
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/4 cups warm water
2 tbsp molasses
2 tbsp vegetable oil
2 cups bread flour
1 cup rye flour
1 tbsp caraway seeds
1 1/2 tsp salt
2 tsp active dry yeast
recipes.instructions:
Add warm water, molasses, and oil to the bread maker pan.
Add bread flour, rye flour, and caraway seeds on top, then salt in one corner.
Make a well and add the yeast, keeping it separate from the salt.
Select the Whole Wheat or Rye cycle if available, with a Medium crust setting, and start the machine.
Let the machine complete its full cycle.
Remove the loaf and cool completely on a rack before slicing.

recipes.title: Bread Maker Multigrain Bread
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/4 cups warm water
2 tbsp honey
2 tbsp vegetable oil
2 cups bread flour
1 cup whole wheat flour
1/3 cup rolled oats
2 tbsp mixed seeds (sunflower, flax, sesame)
1 1/4 tsp salt
2 tsp active dry yeast
recipes.instructions:
Add warm water, honey, and oil to the bread maker pan.
Add bread flour, whole wheat flour, oats, and mixed seeds on top, then salt in one corner.
Make a well in the dry ingredients and add the yeast.
Select the Whole Wheat cycle with a Medium crust setting and start the machine.
Let the machine complete its full mixing, rising, and baking cycle.
Cool the loaf completely on a rack before slicing.

recipes.title: Bread Maker Oatmeal Bread
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup warm milk
1/3 cup warm water
2 tbsp butter, softened
3 tbsp brown sugar
1 cup rolled oats
3 cups bread flour
1 1/4 tsp salt
2 tsp active dry yeast
recipes.instructions:
Add warm milk, water, and butter to the bread maker pan, followed by brown sugar.
Add the oats and bread flour on top, then salt in one corner.
Make a well and add the yeast.
Select the Basic Bread cycle with a Medium crust setting and start the machine.
Let the machine run through its complete cycle without opening the lid.
Remove the loaf and cool on a rack before slicing.

recipes.title: Bread Maker Potato Bread
recipes.ingredients:
3/4 cup warm water
1/2 cup mashed potatoes (cooled)
2 tbsp butter, softened
2 tbsp sugar
1 1/4 tsp salt
3 cups bread flour
2 1/4 tsp active dry yeast
recipes.instructions:
Add warm water, mashed potatoes, and butter to the bread maker pan, followed by sugar and salt.
Add the bread flour on top, covering the wet ingredients.
Make a well in the flour and add the yeast.
Select the Basic Bread cycle with a Medium crust setting and start the machine.
Let the machine complete its full cycle; the potato adds moisture so the loaf will be extra soft.
Remove and cool completely on a rack before slicing.

recipes.title: Bread Maker Cinnamon Raisin Bread
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup warm milk
2 tbsp butter, softened
3 tbsp sugar
1 tsp salt
3 cups bread flour
1 tbsp cinnamon
2 1/4 tsp active dry yeast
3/4 cup raisins
recipes.instructions:
Add warm milk and butter to the bread maker pan, followed by sugar and salt.
Add the bread flour and cinnamon on top.
Make a well in the flour and add the yeast.
Select the Sweet Bread or Basic cycle with a raisin/nut add-in alert if your machine has one, and add the raisins when it beeps, or stir them in about 5 minutes before the final knead ends.
Let the machine complete its full cycle.
Cool completely on a rack before slicing.

recipes.title: Bread Maker Brioche Loaf
recipes.ingredients:
3 eggs, room temperature
1/3 cup warm milk
1/4 cup sugar
1 tsp salt
3 cups bread flour
6 tbsp butter, softened and cubed
2 1/4 tsp active dry yeast
recipes.instructions:
Add the beaten eggs and warm milk to the bread maker pan, followed by sugar and salt.
Add the bread flour on top, then scatter the cubed butter over the flour.
Make a well and add the yeast.
Select the Sweet Bread or Basic cycle with a Light or Medium crust setting and start the machine.
Let the machine complete its full mixing, rising, and baking cycle.
Cool the rich, buttery loaf on a rack before slicing.

recipes.title: Bread Maker Banana Bread
recipes.ingredients:
3 ripe bananas, mashed
2 eggs
1/3 cup vegetable oil
3/4 cup sugar
1 3/4 cups flour
1 tsp baking soda
1/2 tsp salt
1/2 tsp cinnamon
1/2 cup chopped walnuts (optional)
recipes.instructions:
Whisk mashed bananas, eggs, oil, and sugar together in a bowl, then pour into the bread maker pan.
In a separate bowl, whisk flour, baking soda, salt, and cinnamon, then add to the pan on top of the wet ingredients.
Sprinkle walnuts on top if using.
Select the Quick Bread or Cake cycle, which uses baking soda instead of yeast for a shorter, no-rise bake.
Let the machine complete its full mixing and baking cycle without opening the lid.
Cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a rack to cool completely before slicing.

recipes.title: Bread Maker Pumpkin Bread
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup canned pumpkin puree
2 eggs
1/3 cup vegetable oil
3/4 cup sugar
1 3/4 cups flour
1 tsp baking soda
1/2 tsp salt
1 tsp cinnamon
1/2 tsp nutmeg
1/4 tsp ground cloves
recipes.instructions:
Whisk pumpkin puree, eggs, oil, and sugar together, then pour into the bread maker pan.
Whisk flour, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg, and cloves together and add on top of the wet ingredients.
Select the Quick Bread or Cake cycle on the machine.
Let the machine complete its full mixing and baking cycle.
Cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a rack to cool completely.
Slice and serve plain or with a dusting of powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Bread Maker Herb and Garlic Bread
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/4 cups warm water
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tbsp sugar
1 1/2 tsp salt
3 cups bread flour
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tsp dried oregano
1 tsp dried basil
2 1/4 tsp active dry yeast
recipes.instructions:
Add warm water and olive oil to the bread maker pan, followed by sugar and salt.
Add the bread flour, garlic, oregano, and basil on top.
Make a well in the flour and add the yeast.
Select the Basic Bread cycle with a Medium crust setting and start the machine.
Let the machine complete its full cycle.
Cool on a rack before slicing; great alongside pasta or soup.

recipes.title: Bread Maker Rosemary Olive Oil Bread
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/4 cups warm water
1/4 cup olive oil
1 tbsp sugar
1 1/2 tsp salt
3 cups bread flour
1 tbsp chopped fresh rosemary
2 1/4 tsp active dry yeast
recipes.instructions:
Add warm water and olive oil to the bread maker pan, followed by sugar and salt.
Add the bread flour and rosemary on top.
Make a well in the flour and add the yeast.
Select the Basic Bread cycle with a Medium crust setting and start the machine.
Let the machine complete its full cycle.
Cool on a rack before slicing and serve with extra olive oil for dipping.

recipes.title: Bread Maker Cheddar Jalapeno Bread
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup warm water
1 tbsp sugar
1 1/2 tsp salt
3 cups bread flour
1 cup shredded cheddar cheese
2 tbsp diced pickled jalapenos
2 1/4 tsp active dry yeast
recipes.instructions:
Add warm water to the bread maker pan, followed by sugar and salt.
Add the bread flour, cheddar cheese, and jalapenos on top.
Make a well in the flour and add the yeast.
Select the Basic Bread cycle with a Medium crust setting and start the machine.
Let the machine complete its full mixing, rising, and baking cycle.
Cool slightly on a rack before slicing; delicious warm with butter.

recipes.title: Bread Maker Milk Bread
recipes.ingredients:
1/4 cup flour
1/2 cup water
3/4 cup warm milk
3 tbsp sugar
1 1/4 tsp salt
3 cups bread flour
3 tbsp butter, softened
2 1/4 tsp active dry yeast
recipes.instructions:
Whisk the 1/4 cup flour with the 1/2 cup water in a small saucepan and cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until thickened into a paste; let cool.
Add the cooled paste and warm milk to the bread maker pan, followed by sugar and salt.
Add the bread flour on top, then scatter the softened butter over the flour.
Make a well and add the yeast.
Select the Basic Bread cycle with a Light crust setting and start the machine.
Let the machine complete its cycle, then cool the ultra-soft loaf on a rack before slicing.

recipes.title: Bread Maker Pizza Dough
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/3 cups warm water
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp sugar
1 1/2 tsp salt
3 1/2 cups bread flour
2 tsp active dry yeast
recipes.instructions:
Add warm water and olive oil to the bread maker pan, followed by sugar and salt.
Add the bread flour on top.
Make a well in the flour and add the yeast.
Select the Dough cycle and start the machine; this mixes and lets the dough rise without baking it.
Once the cycle finishes, remove the dough, punch it down, and divide into portions for individual pizzas.
Shape, top as desired, and bake in a hot oven at 475F for 10-12 minutes until golden.

recipes.title: Bread Maker Dinner Rolls Dough
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup warm milk
1/4 cup butter, softened
3 tbsp sugar
1 egg
1 tsp salt
3 1/4 cups bread flour
2 1/4 tsp active dry yeast
recipes.instructions:
Add warm milk, butter, and egg to the bread maker pan, followed by sugar and salt.
Add the bread flour on top.
Make a well in the flour and add the yeast.
Select the Dough cycle and start the machine.
Once the cycle finishes, shape the dough into 12 rolls, place in a greased baking pan, and let rise 30 minutes.
Bake in a preheated 350F oven for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.

recipes.title: Bread Maker Bagel Dough
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/3 cups warm water
1 tbsp sugar
1 1/2 tsp salt
3 1/2 cups bread flour
2 1/4 tsp active dry yeast
2 tbsp honey (for boiling water)
1 egg white, beaten (for topping)
Sesame or poppy seeds (optional)
recipes.instructions:
Add warm water to the bread maker pan, followed by sugar and salt.
Add the bread flour on top.
Make a well in the flour and add the yeast.
Select the Dough cycle and start the machine.
Once the cycle finishes, divide the dough into 8 pieces, shape into rings, and let rest 10 minutes; boil each bagel in water with honey for 1 minute per side.
Brush with egg white, sprinkle with seeds if desired, and bake at 425F for 20-22 minutes until golden.

recipes.title: Bread Maker Soft Pretzel Dough
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups warm water
1 tbsp sugar
2 tsp salt
4 cups bread flour
2 1/4 tsp active dry yeast
1/3 cup baking soda (for boiling water)
1 egg, beaten (for topping)
Coarse pretzel salt
recipes.instructions:
Add warm water to the bread maker pan, followed by sugar and salt.
Add the bread flour on top.
Make a well in the flour and add the yeast.
Select the Dough cycle and start the machine.
Once the cycle finishes, divide into 8 pieces, roll into ropes, and shape into pretzels; boil briefly in water with baking soda, then brush with egg and sprinkle with pretzel salt.
Bake at 425F for 12-15 minutes until deep golden brown.

recipes.title: Bread Maker Cinnamon Rolls
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup warm milk
1/4 cup butter, softened
1/3 cup sugar
1 egg
1 tsp salt
4 cups bread flour
2 1/4 tsp active dry yeast
1/2 cup brown sugar
2 tbsp cinnamon
4 tbsp butter, softened (for filling)
1 cup powdered sugar mixed with 2 tbsp milk (for glaze)
recipes.instructions:
Add warm milk, butter, sugar, and egg to the bread maker pan, followed by salt.
Add the bread flour on top, then make a well and add the yeast.
Select the Dough cycle and start the machine.
Once the cycle finishes, roll the dough into a rectangle, spread with softened butter, and sprinkle with brown sugar and cinnamon; roll up tightly and slice into 9 rolls.
Place rolls in a greased baking pan, let rise 30 minutes, then bake at 350F for 22-25 minutes until golden.
Drizzle with the powdered sugar glaze while warm.

recipes.title: Bread Maker Focaccia Dough
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/3 cups warm water
1/3 cup olive oil, divided
1 tsp sugar
2 tsp salt
3 1/2 cups bread flour
2 tsp active dry yeast
1 tbsp chopped fresh rosemary
Flaky sea salt, for topping
recipes.instructions:
Add warm water and half the olive oil to the bread maker pan, followed by sugar and salt.
Add the bread flour on top.
Make a well in the flour and add the yeast.
Select the Dough cycle and start the machine.
Once the cycle finishes, spread the dough into an oiled sheet pan, dimple all over with your fingers, drizzle with remaining olive oil, and sprinkle with rosemary and flaky salt.
Let rise 30 minutes, then bake at 425F for 20-25 minutes until golden.

recipes.title: Bread Maker Challah
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup warm water
3 tbsp honey
1/3 cup vegetable oil
2 eggs
1 1/2 tsp salt
3 1/2 cups bread flour
2 1/4 tsp active dry yeast
1 egg yolk, beaten (for topping)
recipes.instructions:
Add warm water, honey, oil, and eggs to the bread maker pan, followed by salt.
Add the bread flour on top.
Make a well in the flour and add the yeast.
Select the Dough cycle so the loaf can be shaped and braided; once finished, divide the dough into three strands and braid them together.
Place the braided loaf on a baking sheet, let rise 30-40 minutes, then brush with beaten egg yolk.
Bake at 350F for 25-30 minutes until deep golden brown and hollow-sounding when tapped.

recipes.title: Bread Maker Gluten-Free White Bread
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups warm water
3 eggs
3 tbsp vegetable oil
2 tbsp honey
3 cups gluten-free flour blend
1 tbsp xanthan gum (if not included in the blend)
1 1/2 tsp salt
2 1/4 tsp active dry yeast
recipes.instructions:
Add warm water, eggs, oil, and honey to the bread maker pan.
Add the gluten-free flour blend, xanthan gum, and salt on top.
Make a well and add the yeast.
Select the Gluten-Free cycle if your machine has one, or the Basic cycle with a shorter rise; gluten-free doughs are stirred rather than kneaded traditionally, so batter will be thicker than standard dough.
Let the machine complete its full cycle without opening the lid, since gluten-free loaves are sensitive to temperature changes during rising.
Cool completely on a rack before slicing, as gluten-free bread firms up as it cools.

recipes.title: Bread Maker Zucchini Bread
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups grated zucchini, squeezed dry
2 eggs
1/3 cup vegetable oil
3/4 cup sugar
1 3/4 cups flour
1 tsp baking soda
1/2 tsp salt
1 tsp cinnamon
1/2 cup chopped walnuts (optional)
recipes.instructions:
Whisk grated zucchini, eggs, oil, and sugar together, then pour into the bread maker pan.
Whisk flour, baking soda, salt, and cinnamon together and add on top of the wet ingredients.
Sprinkle walnuts on top if using.
Select the Quick Bread or Cake cycle on the machine.
Let the machine complete its full mixing and baking cycle without opening the lid.
Cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a rack to cool completely before slicing.
